items.title: 前开发者称不干预原作创作者 质量效应新作能成佳作
items.summary: 曾参与初代《质量效应》系列的前开发者表示，他坚信下一部作品能成为佳作，前提是无人干涉开发团队的规划。阿曼多·特罗伊西曾担任《质量效应》过场动画设计师、《质量效应2》首席过场动画设计师，还曾出任《光环4》叙事总监。在接受F

content.v: 曾参与初代《质量效应》系列的前开发者表示，他坚信下一部作品能成为佳作，前提是无人干涉开发团队的规划。
阿曼多·特罗伊西曾担任《质量效应》过场动画设计师、《质量效应2》首席过场动画设计师，还曾出任《光环4》叙事总监。在接受FRVR采访时，他被问及对BioWare开发《质量效应》新作的团队有何建议。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788573512_624001_jpg_r.jpg
特罗伊西回应称，这支团队不需要他的任何建议，尤其是因为参与过初代三部曲的开发者——比如首席设计师普雷斯顿·瓦塔马纽克、艺术总监德里克·沃茨、首席过场动画师帕里什·莱——仍在BioWare任职，对工作驾轻就熟。
“我很难给出什么建议，因为参与这个项目的很多人都是当初开发原作的老人，”特罗伊西解释道，“他们都懂。普雷斯顿在，德里克在，帕里什也在，他们都是元老级人物，对吧?我不觉得我能说出什么他们不知道的道理。”
“当年《质量效应2》开发结束我离职时，所有人都在卡片上写了留言……普雷斯顿写了‘热情与技艺铸就卓越’……我觉得他们两者兼备，所以我给不出什么新的建议。这些事他们门儿清。”
特罗伊西认为，下一部《质量效应》能否成功，关键在于这些原作创作者和团队其他成员能否获得充分的自主权，打造出他们理想中的游戏。这番话显然呼应了此前的报道：《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》开发不顺，是因为BioWare一度被要求将其打造成服务型游戏，直到最后一刻才调整计划。
“道理就是这样，如果人们别插手，让游戏创作者专心做自己的事，你永远想不到他们能创造出怎样的惊喜，”他说道。
“当然，开发这种体量的游戏会牵扯到方方面面的因素。但要相信你的团队，试着用你所做的一切去改变世界。我觉得他们能做到，我支持他们。”
他补充道：“我们的愿景一直很清晰。BioWare有自己的一套创作公式，他们会在这套公式的基础上迭代优化，持续推出业界顶尖的电影化RPG，这基本上就是我们的核心使命。”
“后来他们不得不经历服务型游戏的浪潮——这股浪潮如今仍在，只是没那么盛行而已——我们所有人都要受制于公司、股东以及其他方方面面。”
“我认为，当BioWare回归本心，专注做单人、互动叙事驱动、战斗有深度、注重成长的游戏时，真的无人能及。”
“这就有点像《光环》里的士官长，相当于踏上历练之旅，找回自我后再度回归。我觉得只要我们不去干扰BioWare，让他们专心做自己最擅长的事，他们就能做到。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: DLSS5增加显卡功耗：显卡越强功耗越高 RTX 5090最明显
items.summary: NVIDIA的DLSS5技术如今已经随着NBA2K27正式上线了，目前主要支持RTX 50系列显卡，游戏数量也有待扩展，这是后续要解决的问题。从年初发布以来，DLSS5的争议声就很大，有担心画质变形的，有担心游戏开发商会

content.v: NVIDIA的DLSS5技术如今已经随着NBA2K27正式上线了，目前主要支持RTX 50系列显卡，游戏数量也有待扩展，这是后续要解决的问题。
从年初发布以来，DLSS5的争议声就很大，有担心画质变形的，有担心游戏开发商会因此偷懒的，这方面的讨论很多，这两天有大量的国内外评测发布，大家可以参考本站的首发评测——第一款支持DLSS 5的游戏！《NBA 2K27》首发硬件测试。
除了大家关心的性能与画质问题之外，还有个问题需要提及，那就是DLSS5技术也会增加显卡的功耗，德国Computerbase网站的评测有着详细的结果，如下所示：
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788573101_903005.png
他们对比了RTX 5060到RTX 5090在内的多款显卡在2K及4K分辨率下开启与关闭DLSS5的功耗情况，结果一目了然。
先说结论，DLSS5是会提升显卡功耗的，毕竟DLSS5的负载不低，相当于显卡在额外跑一个本地大模型，负载提升了，理论上功耗自然会增加。
但具体增加多少功耗要看显卡情况，RTX 5060显卡的功耗增加几乎是可以忽略不计的，RTX 5060 Ti、RTX 5070大约增加了10%的功耗，但绝对值还算可以接受。
RTX 5070 Ti的功耗差距在2K下就比较明显，4K下差距缩小到10%左右。
但RTX 5080及RTX 5090两款高端显卡就有非常明显的功耗增加了，提升幅度大约在60%，4K下涨幅明显降低，RTX 5090也就增加了40%的功耗，RTX 5080增加了大约25%的功耗。
综合来看的话，DLSS5对性能越强的显卡有着更明显的功耗增加，2K下比4K下涨幅更多。
至于功耗大涨的原因，原文也没解释出来，按理说DLSS5应该是用的显卡的张量核心，以往的DLSS倒也没有大幅提升功耗，不过它们在超分及光追重建上的要求也低于DLSS5。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 6350元！全球首款Wi-Fi 8路由器上市 下载速度惊人
items.summary: 快科技9月5日消息，华硕正式对外官宣，旗下最新推出的Wi-Fi 8电竞路由器ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列，已经率先在加拿大市场开售，这也…

content.v: 快科技9月5日消息，华硕正式对外官宣，旗下最新推出的Wi-Fi 8电竞路由器ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列，已经率先在加拿大市场开售，这也是全球首款正式面向普通消费者上市的Wi-Fi 8消费级路由器。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050949089825.png
目前ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro已经在华硕加拿大官方商城开启预订，官方定价为1299.99加元，折合人民币约6350元。
除了率先启动预售的加拿大市场之外，这个系列产品预计会在10月面向全球其他地区同步开启正式发售，不同区域会推出适配当地无线电频谱规则的专属版本。
整个ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列一共包含两款不同定位的型号，分别是GT-BN98 Pro也就是BN30000版本，和GT-BN98也就是BN25000版本，面向不同区域的市场做了针对性的频段适配。
两款产品核心都采用了四频Wi-Fi 8的架构设计，最主要的区别就是对应的频段组合不同。
GT-BN98 Pro面向北美市场推出，采用的频段组合是双6GHz频段加5GHz加2.4GHz，GT-BN98则面向欧洲、中东、非洲及亚太市场推出，频段组合为6GHz加双5GHz加2.4GHz，完全适配不同地区的无线电管制规则。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050949174690.png
硬件配置层面，整个系列都搭载主频为2.6GHz的四核高性能处理器，标配2GB运行内存和256MB闪存，整机的性能冗余完全足够支撑高带宽环境下的长时间稳定运行。
无线规格上，每个独立频段都支持4T4R收发和4096-QAM调制方案，GT-BN98 Pro的理论总吞吐量可以达到30000Mbps，GT-BN98的理论总吞吐量也有25000Mbps。有线接口方面，该系列路由器配备2个10Gbps网口与4个2.5Gbps LAN口，还支持20Gbps链路聚合，完全可以匹配当前全万兆的家庭内网搭建需求。
华硕官方对外说明，就算用户现阶段家里用的还是Wi-Fi 7标准的终端设备，这款新的Wi-Fi 8路由器也能带来可量化感知的实际性能提升。
等到后续兼容Wi-Fi 8的终端设备陆续批量上市之后，UEQM不等调制和NPCA非主信道接入等Wi-Fi 8专属新特性，还能进一步提升多设备场景下的连接稳定性，大幅降低不同设备之间的信号干扰影响。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050949262733.jpg
需要特意说明的是，这款路由器标注的30Gbps总吞吐量，是4个独立Wi-Fi频段全部叠加计算出来的理论无线上限，代表的是多台设备同时高速传输数据时，整机可以承载的合计最高数据流量能达到3.75GB/s。
如果真的能跑满这个带宽上限，日常的文件传输体验会相当夸张，比如一个100GB的大型高清素材文件，只需要26.7秒就能完成全速下载，效率是当前主流Wi-Fi 7千兆内网的数倍。

content.v: 一家独大更容易XX正确或者垄断主观？或许不少当事者是这么想的，目前游戏圈最大级别的游戏评论站M也引发了不少业者的不满，日前开发过《奥日与黑暗森林》的Moon Studios工作室CEO·Thomas Mahler宣布成立全新评价网站“VideoGamesCritic”，主旨就是“比起媒体更重视玩家的意见！”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788572614_865554.webp
·Moon Studios工作室的新作《No Rest for the Wicked》正在抢先体验中，让工作室CEO暴怒怒怼M站的原因也正是这部游戏，游戏刚刚推出时差评不断，但工作室认为正在积极修正，现在风评已经恢复。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788572625_458122.png
·问题来了，其他平台的即时评论形势正在好转，但是M站的评论依旧停留在当初的差评低分阶段，Thomas Mahler认为M站的最大问题就是评价更新不及时以及更侧重媒体的评分而忽视玩家的意见。
·Thomas Mahler指出同样深受M站其害的还有《无人深空》，这款业界和玩家都公认的励志神作如今已经好评爆表但是M站评分几乎没变过还是初期的惨不忍睹，这对于那些肯不断修正游戏问题的工作室极不公平，而且那些喜欢盯着M站评分找游戏玩的玩家也会被误导。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788572638_502433.webp
所以Thomas Mahler宣布成立全新评价网站“VideoGamesCritic”主打两大核心评价标准， 更侧重玩家意见以及及时更新最新评价 ，目前M站对此事尚没有回应，不知道今后会不会暗改。

items.title: 《黎明行者之血》延时Mod爆火 抛弃游戏核心设计？
items.summary: 《黎明行者之血》发售仅两天，Nexus Mods上最受欢迎的MOD却是一个直接对抗游戏核心设计的存在

content.v: 《黎明行者之血》发售仅两天，Nexus Mods上最受欢迎的MOD却是一个直接对抗游戏核心设计的存在——Better Story Timer以超过4.5万次的下载量遥遥领先，几乎是第二名（解锁过场动画帧率限制，1.6万次）的三倍。这款MOD的主题简单直接：让玩家不用再急着救家人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050936224324.png
在原版游戏中，玩家需要在30天内完成拯救家人的主线任务，每一天被划分为8个时段（白天8段、夜晚8段），总计约480个时间单位。几乎所有行动都会消耗时间——从推进支线任务到解锁技能树的每个节点，都需要消耗时段。这种设计旨在营造紧迫感，但显然并非所有玩家都享受这种压力。
Better Story Timer将时限从30天延长至90天，允许玩家将每天时段从8个增至最多32个，并可移除升级天赋时的时间消耗。这意味着玩家可以腾出更多时间探索世界而非盯着倒计时，但也在本质上削弱了游戏最核心的张力来源——当时间不再是稀缺资源时，原本以紧迫感驱动的体验便失去了重要支撑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050936326444.png
发售当天即出现这样的MOD，并且以如此悬殊的下载量领先，也说明相当一部分玩家对“时间压力”本身并不买账。如果游戏的设计师希望玩家感受到“来不及”，而玩家第一时间就想摆脱这种感觉，那么“30天倒计时”究竟是成功的机制，还是绕了弯路的设计，可能要到游戏上市一段时间后才有更清晰的答案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050936336134.png
你会为了更自由地探索世界而安装这款MOD，还是愿意在30天的限制下体验原汁原味的紧迫感？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的选择。

items.title: 《暗影蜘蛛侠》口碑爆棚 烂番茄92%却确认没有续集
items.summary: 据variety报道，Prime Video与MGM+联合推出的漫威剧集《暗影蜘蛛侠》（Spider-Noir）在播出第一季、共8集后正式被取消，后续将不会…

content.v: 据variety报道，Prime Video与MGM+联合推出的漫威剧集《暗影蜘蛛侠》（Spider-Noir）在播出第一季、共8集后正式被取消，后续将不会推出第二季。该剧由尼古拉斯·凯奇主演。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050934578204.png
值得一提的是，《暗影蜘蛛侠》虽然口碑表现不俗，却依然没能获得续订。该剧目前在烂番茄拥有92%的新鲜度，观众评分也达到90%。豆瓣评分为7.2。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050934584196.png
《暗影蜘蛛侠》今年获得了11项艾美奖提名，是Prime Video今年获得提名最多的剧集之一，涵盖摄影、音效、特效、特技、服装与化妆等多个技术奖项。
《暗影蜘蛛侠》故事背景设定于美国大萧条时期。尼古拉斯·凯奇饰演本·莱利，一名生活潦倒的纽约私家侦探，在经历个人悲剧后被迫面对自己的过去，并成为这座城市唯一的超级英雄。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050935085486.png
该剧也是亚马逊与索尼影视娱乐合作开发“索尼影视漫威角色宇宙”后推出的首部漫威相关剧集。据称双方合作的另一部作品目前已经进入开发阶段，预计很快公布更多消息。

items.title: 索尼游戏卖太贵 海外破解生意兴起:外置硬盘即插即用
items.summary: 据外媒报道，拉丁美洲部分地区的主机破解产业正在逐渐商业化。

content.v: 据外媒报道，拉丁美洲部分地区的主机破解产业正在逐渐商业化。在秘鲁首都利马，知名商业中心Polvos Azules长期存在主机改机及相关服务，如今当地商家甚至推出了“破解主机+外置硬盘”的现成解决方案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050918465828.png
当地玩家选择破解的重要原因之一，是正版游戏价格相对高昂。索尼的新作通常按照国际美元价格销售，对于收入水平较低的玩家而言，一款正版游戏可能就相当于不小的生活开支，因此破解服务一直存在市场。
过去，向破解后的PS4安装大量游戏通常需要在店内等待数小时。如今，当地商家开始使用预先配置好的500GB或1TB外置硬盘。玩家只需通过USB连接主机，启动相应程序后即可直接读取硬盘中的游戏内容，整个准备过程大约只需5分钟。
据当地一家名为Yorbi Games的店主介绍，这类硬盘还可以预装大量游戏以及Linux系统和模拟器等工具，进一步拓展主机的使用方式。
价格也是这类服务最大的吸引力之一。一块1TB、已经配置好游戏的外置硬盘售价约300秘鲁索尔，基本相当于一款正版新游戏的价格。
目前，这套方案要求PS4系统版本不高于13.00。当地改机商还会通过修改系统设置阻止主机自动更新，以避免破解环境因系统升级而失效。

items.title: Epic CEO：游戏业正经历雅达利大崩溃以来第二次崩溃
items.summary: Epic Games首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼称游戏行业目前正在经历自1983年雅达利大崩溃以来的第二次重大崩溃

content.v: Epic Games首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼近日在接受《Edge》杂志采访时发出严厉警告，称游戏行业目前正在经历自1983年雅达利大崩溃以来的第二次重大崩溃，而AI投资热潮是此次危机的核心推手。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050912537067.png
斯威尼指出，当前游戏硬件的核心问题源于整个行业正在被AI和数据中心投资挤出芯片供应链。“AI领域正以前所未有的规模进行投资，基于AI将在经济中发挥变革性作用的信念，它们有能力在元器件供应上出价超过整个娱乐产业。”他直言，“所以我们成了被挤掉的一方，RAM和存储的价格正在翻倍甚至四倍增长，而且可能不会就此停下。”
他预测，未来三年内游戏硬件将面临持续的供应危机。唯一的长远解决方案是建设大型芯片工厂以满足全球产能需求，但这需要时间。斯威尼的言论与Xbox CEO阿莎·夏尔马此前的表态一致——夏尔马也曾指出，自她上任以来，内存价格已“暴涨”，下一代主机Project Helix的上市甚至可能因内存危机而推迟。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050913071411.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050913076924.png
斯威尼的这番警示，也再次印证了游戏行业正面临一场由外部技术浪潮引发的结构性危机。面对未来三年可能持续上涨的硬件价格，你会选择在主机发售后立刻入手，还是等待硬件价格回落后再做决定？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的看法。

items.title: 曝《GTA6》登PC会比想象中早！因主机缺货严重
items.summary: 《GTA6》PC版本的发售时间可能比外界预想的要快得多。

content.v: 根据外媒Tech4Gamers的报道，尽管《GTA6》已确认在首发时为主机独占，但其PC版本的发售时间可能比外界预想的要快得多。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050857226667.png
Video Games Chronicle（VGC）的记者安迪·罗宾逊（Andy Robinson）在近日的播客中表示，行业内已有“一些声音”指向《GTA6》的PC版会“出乎意料地快”到来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050857526763.png
罗宾逊认为，PS5及PS5 Pro主机在游戏发售时可能因需求过大而出现供货短缺，这或许会促使Rockstar Games加速PC版的推出进程。此外，现代主机的硬件架构与PC已高度相似，这将为《GTA6》PC版的移植工作带来便利，也是推动其更快上市的重要因素。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/05/small_202609050857541571.png
相比之下，前作在主机版发售长达19个月后才登陆PC平台。如果本次关于PC版加速的传闻属实，对无数PC玩家而言无疑是一个巨大的惊喜。

items.title: September's schedule of new games, events, and updates refuses to let 2026 go down in history as a slow year for new releases
items.summary: Well, the honor truly belongs to fall in general, but let's take this one month at a time.

content.v: After a quiet few months, September finally hits the gas, and our list of monthly PC game happenings is filled with brand new adventures, series continuations, 1.0 updates, and events galore. I'm still playing catch-up after Gamescom, and now we've got Tokyo Game Show queued up soon. It's the same schedule every year, but somehow I'm always caught off guard.

The Blood of Dawnwalker kicked off the month with a delightfully dismal vampire RPG from the Witcher veterans at Rebel Wolves. Then you've got all month to suck blood as Coen (or be a good two-shoes and abstain, I guess) before Silent Hill: Townfall and Control Resonant launch on the same damn day. It seems everything I've been waiting all year to play has crammed into this 4-week window, and that's not even counting all the big updates.

The Witcher 3 Remastered is easily among the most notable updates, and everyone who owns the original gets the RPG's makeover for free (along with its DLC). It'll be my first time playing, so between that and Valheim 1.0, I'll be plenty busy until 2027.

各位好，今天让我们来聊聊角色扮演游戏以及“借鉴”！
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-12148Sb.png
我不会局限于电子游戏领域，而是着眼于广阔而奇妙的桌面角色扮演游戏世界，与各位一同领略那些有趣的机制和风格。其中有太多东西值得借鉴、移植到电子游戏中，让我们开始吧！

简单介绍一下自己，我是埃文·希尔，从事关卡设计工作有十年了。我目前在黑曜石工作室参与制作《天外世界 2》（Outer Worlds 2），曾在顽皮狗（Naughty Dog）参与制作了《最后生还者 2》（The Last of Us Part Two）。此外我还参与制作过《折磨：扭蒙拉之潮》（Torment: Tides of Numenera）、《太阳灰国》（Solar Ash）以及一款名为《帕里亚》（Palia）的游戏。有一点必须强调一下，《折磨：扭蒙拉之潮》是《异域镇魂曲》（Planescape: Torment）的精神续作，它是少数几款使用蒙特·库克（Monte Cook）的 Cypher 系统的大型游戏之一。这个系统和《龙与地下城》（DND）有着很大的差异而且相当复杂，这里不做讨论，让我们直接进入“借鉴”环节。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-2_cn2162LH.jpg
我准备了多个分享主题，每个主题都包含一些游戏案例，我会分析并研究它们的机制，看看如何“借鉴”并将其“应用”到我们的电子游戏中。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-3_cn2174AY.jpg
我们会讨论六个主题：角色与时间，基本就是角色属性之类的有趣内容；一些奇怪的机制允许你通过特殊方式玩游戏，而非简单地扔骰子；精简而美好的单页 RPG 里的奇怪有趣的内容；古老的知识，一些人试图重现桌面角色扮演游戏最辉煌的时代；我暂时不打算解释什么是“迪斯科迷雾启示录”（Disco Mist Apocalypse），等讲到的时候你就明白了；最后是总结。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-421927v.png
如果要讨论“借鉴”，约翰·哈珀（John Harper）的《暗夜冷锋》（Blades in the Dark）是个绕不开的话题。
追敘
这是一套杰出的游戏规则，如果你没听说过《暗夜冷锋》，可以把它当作桌面版的《耻辱》（Dishonored）。这套规则中有我们要讲的第一个机制，“追敘”（Flashbacks）。就像所有侠盗电影中那样，玩家会在游戏中遇到重重阻碍。但不同之处在于，玩家不必等问题出现后想办法解决，而是可以“追敘”到过去，在问题出现之前让其消弭于无形。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-52261zN.png
比如拐角处有个警卫，常规做法是潜行过去或者用非致命手段解决他，但在《暗夜冷锋》中，我可以回到一周前，胁迫或贿赂他，然后再回到现在，看看能否成功解决这个问题。
我们能看到这种机制的潜力，许多游戏已经成功应用了这一点。当我们设置一个障碍，玩家不一定非要用手中的工具去解决，而是拥有大量选项。这样我们就可以提供更多社交玩法，将一些并非击晕、潜行、即时可用装备等常规手段的能力，真正纳入到游戏循环中去。
比如《刺客信条》（Assassin's Creed），这个系列的 RPG 化程度越来越重了。想象一下，我们在扮演艾吉奥（Ezio）时，能像刺穿守卫的脖子一样轻松贿赂他们，肯定很有意思。
压力与创伤
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-6_cn2278cQ.jpg
你可能会好奇，《暗夜冷锋》要如何平衡时间旅行这种强大的能力。它使用了压力系统，“压力”是游戏中的一种可消耗资源，也是衡量玩家角色心理健康的指标。每当你进行追叙、强迫自己再次掷骰或是抵消一些无法接受的后果时（如将致死伤转化为轻伤），你就会获得压力。压力很难消除，如果压力条积累到满格，玩家将获得永久负面状态“创伤”。
压力系统的杰出之处在于它不只是第二个血条，而是一种真实、可感知的资源。它并非“我能承受精神伤害吗？”而是“我在努力逼迫自己前进”“我强迫身体超越原本的极限，看看结果会怎么样”。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-7_cn2294in.jpg
《暗黑地牢》（Darkest Dungeon）就是成功应用“压力”系统的范例。尽管我觉得它的压力还是有点像第二血条，或是“精神血条”，但重点在于，“压力增加会造成长远影响”的理念值得学习。就像我说的那样，压力不只是第二个血条。
进度钟
让我们进入下一个话题，“进度钟”（Progress Clock）。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-82314X2.png
《暗夜冷锋》的游戏机制很独特，没有一般意义上的任务日志，也没有追踪目标、道具栏或者血条。你可以用非常简单的圆圈和笔记卡片来跟踪无数的线程和事件，很快，情况就会变成上面这样。
在《暗夜冷锋》中，进度钟可以代表任何东西，它可以衡量守卫的警觉度，可以是你对吸血鬼的调查进度，也可以是狼人暴动的倒计时。这是一种灵活、直观的工具，每当玩家进行追叙，获取压力，或接近失败，主持人就可以推动进度钟作为回应。这种机制创造了一种不断收紧的“进度钟体验”，玩家的每次行动都会对各种线索、故事和状态产生复杂的影响。
我们不可能编写出囊括潜行游戏中所有状况的规则——光一个守卫警戒度系统就足够复杂了。还不如把这些规则都浓缩、集中起来。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-9_cn2327il.jpg
那么，要如何在电子游戏中实现呢？我认为《辐射：新维加斯》（Fallout: New Vegas，上图左）是个很好的例子，我们可以把“进度钟”搬进电子游戏的任务系统里面，许多任务都可以适配这种增量模式。《瘟疫 2》（Pathologic 2，上图右）也有类似系统，不过它使用的是现实中的时钟，我们稍后会讲到。
说完了《暗夜冷锋》，现在我们来聊聊《燃烧的车轮》（Burning Wheel）和《精灵鼠小兵》（Mouse Guard）。
信念与直觉
《燃烧的车轮》是一套广受喜爱的 TRPG 规则。起初，卢克·凯恩（Luke Crane）构建了这套模糊的奇幻风格角色扮演系统框架，然后他和大卫·皮特森（David Peterson）一起创作出了《燃烧的车轮》的全面升级版《精灵鼠小兵》。后者会带给玩家一种由角色驱动的微妙体验，角色的属性、特征以及身份会随时间而改变，这一切都是通过信念（Beliefs）与直觉（Instincts）实现的。
在《精灵鼠小兵》中，你身处一个由半人半鼠的小家伙们组成的中世纪社会，这里有一系列关于角色、职业、身份、意识形态的规则，你扮演这个复杂的小型社会的一部分。那么《燃烧的车轮》和《精灵鼠小兵》是如何定义信念与直觉呢？
信念必须是切实可信的，是角色对世界的具体理解。这是一种立场，不是像“哦，我相信希望能拯救世界”这样的空话，而是“你是一个农民，你在角色表上写下：我是这片土地真正的国王”。或者在《燃烧的车轮》中，这只骑着狼的兽人的信念是：“我必须审问一个精灵、一个矮人和一个人类，看看他们的思维是否和我一样。”或者“去他妈的军团，我要开辟自己的道路。”
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-102357ou.png
左边的小老鼠有一个有趣的小信念：鼠小兵要凭脑思考，用心感受。信念是简单的角色主题，只要遵从角色的信念行事，你就会得到人格点数或资源，来推动故事发展与角色成长。
直觉是角色不假思索就会做的事。其有趣之处在于它允许主持人（GM, Game Master）代替玩家做出行动。举个好的直觉例子：我一遇到风吹草动就会拔剑。它的优点是你可以在任何时候取得主动，而缺点是你可能会在错误的场合拔剑，比如法庭上。
突然间，你会面临角色天性带来的抉择，这些抉择一般情况下有利，偶尔有害，但最有趣的是它是动态的。随着时间推移，玩家和角色可以升级并做出改变，如果你的信念是“我将永远守护王子”，那么王子死后会发生什么呢？
需要强调的是，遵从直觉或信念总是能获得奖励，即使这么做会使你身陷险境。你可以对抗直觉，不在法庭上拔剑，但这就意味着放弃额外经验。这种矛盾推动着故事向前发展。
部分玩家可能已经注意到了，这很像《极乐迪斯科》（Disco Elysium）中的警探类型（Copotypes）和思维阁（Thought Cabinet）。显然，《极乐迪斯科》的开发团队很聪明，他们知道借鉴好的内容。
更进一步，在类似《质量效应》（Mass Effect）的角色扮演游戏中应用这种系统，我们就可以展现有趣的角色弧光，比如薛帕德少校（Shepherd）对地球政权的信任或是对不同物种的立场。你可以轻松决定雷克耐虫后（Rakite Queen）的生死，但如果涉及到额外奖励呢？是干掉她获取足够升一级的经验值，还是放过她来改变你的信念或其他属性。我不是你，你可以按自己的想法去做，这就是我做演讲的目的。
恶习与天性
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-11_cn2383ou.jpg
《燃烧的车轮》和《精灵鼠小兵》中有着独特的技能类型，这种技能无关生活或战斗，而是体现在角色的情感方面，这里也存在着大量抉择。我们从《燃烧的车轮》开始，它的规则有点粗糙，但依然很有趣。

《燃烧的车轮》中存在贪婪、悲伤和愤怒等“恶习”（Vice）属性。它们的运作和其他属性一样，当需要用作检定时，你可以根据“恶习”等级投掷一定数量的骰子，也可以将它们和普通属性（例如“剑斗”和“运动”）结合起来使用。只要能证明使用的“恶习”与这次检定的事件相匹配，你就可以用数值更高的恶习替代任意属性。举个例子：你想要某个东西，你的贪婪属性是 4 而魅力是 1，那么你可以用贪婪代替魅力进行检定，从而获得四倍成功率。
“恶习”的负面之处在于，它的等级会随着使用不断升高。“恶习”等级越高，角色的某些行为就越受限。依然拿贪婪举例，如果贪婪等级超过三级，那么即使是一块馅饼，你也不愿意和其他人公平分享。你越是通过“恶习”获取优势，就越是要遵从“恶习”行事。通过“恶习”，玩家获得了弧线、获得了选择，它超越了数值，成为平衡短期利益与长期角色成长的一种方式。

用负面性格构建人物可能容易出问题，《精灵鼠小兵》提出了更好、更简单的替代方案：由于你扮演的是可爱的小老鼠，如果你做一些小老鼠本就会做的事情，比如逃跑、攀爬、躲藏、觅食等，你就可以用“天性”（Nature）代替相关属性。有趣之处在于，你也可以用“天性”来对抗本能，进行诸如站立、战斗、护卫、穿过烈焰等行为，但这么做会消耗“天性”，使它降低一级。如果耗尽了“天性”，短期内你将无法从中获得任何收益，完全恢复可能需要经历好几个场景。总之，“天性”简单易用且效果强大，玩家总是可以在需要时用它强化自己的骰子。

为了平衡消耗“天性”的后果与对角色的影响，如果“天性”耗尽，你的角色会变得偏执、古怪；如果“天性”攒满，你的角色会安于现状，不想出门冒险。两种极端状况都会造成负面影响，游戏会呈现出角色所拥有的两种不同本质之间的矛盾张力——你既是小老鼠，又是一名工匠，或是敢于与猫头鹰正面战斗的勇士。我喜欢这种机制的原因是它既是一种资源，又是一种属性。你可以挥霍、储存、利用它，在这个过程中，你就自然而然地创造出了一个动态的角色。
通过这样一种属性，你就可以创造出一个活灵活现的角色。从看待世界的方式到内心的想法，一切都会随着角色的行动而改变。这样的游戏怎么可能无聊呢？
有很多类似机制可以应用于各种游戏，但让我们继续讲最简单的，容易借鉴的内容。
在《燃烧的车轮》这款通常非常复杂的游戏中，我最喜欢的规则之一是对战规则。它简单得不可思议，战斗双方只需要各自掷骰子比大小，然后造成伤害。没有防御等级（AC, Armor Class），没有战技，而是“我们在酒吧斗殴，我们力气差不多，会发生什么。”你可能会注意到《极乐迪斯科》也使用了这个机制，因为这些制作人非常聪明，我喜欢他们。
下面我们将讨论两款主题截然相反的桌游。在名为《恐惧》（Dread）的生存恐怖游戏中，每次你采取冒险行动，都需要从层层叠（Jenga Tower）中抽取一个木块，如果层层叠倒下，所有人都会死。
而在《星位交错》（Starcrossed）中，玩家将扮演一对恋人，每次采取行动时，你也要从层层叠中抽取一个木块，但当它倒下时，你们要立马开始亲热。紧张焦虑的气氛将被彻底打破。
当跳脱出骰子与纸张的框架后，我们会发现有许多道具也可以营造出引人入胜的氛围与种种变数。《恐惧》与《星位交错》是两个有趣的例子，还有更多有待探索的内容。
有人可能已经开始思考如何将其应用于电子游戏，也可能有人觉得这并不有趣，层层叠依然只是在通过某种方式模拟随机性和多样性。但我认为我们忽略了它的另一面，如果层层叠倒塌就会引发灾难性后果，这其实是在不断给玩家提供“掀桌”选项。拿谈判游戏举例，错误的做法是：“哦，层层叠倒了，我输了。”正确的做法是：“我可以主动决定推倒它中止谈判，退出以保全我的尊严，尽管这么做有损我的名声。”即换一种方式解决问题。
类似场景在潜行游戏中也很常见。拿我参与制作过的《最后生还者》和我最爱的《合金装备》（Metal Gear）举例，潜行失败就像是推倒了层层叠。有时你小心翼翼地潜行，自然推进，却因意外失误被迫开始战斗；有时你受够了繁文缛节，拿着霰弹枪破门而入，大杀特杀。两种玩法都可以有效、有趣、有意义地达成任务目标。

items.title: 随着 Wardogs Steam 并发数突破 20 万，其开发者已为“炒作平息”的那一天做好了准备
items.summary: "Doesn't make it a bad game, or even a problem."

content.v: The way our hobby talks about player counts is all sorts of messed up. Steam concurrents are a useful metric for gauging a game's general popularity, but they paint an incomplete picture. They're a single data point, yet have become the flimsy scaffolding on which the internet builds elaborate headcanon about a game's quality, viability, or deadness. Sometimes dogpiling is so successful, and the resulting perception so difficult to fight, that simply saying a game is dead is enough to help kill it.

It's a trend that annoys me to no end, so it's refreshing to see a developer speaking openly about concurrents—both about how many it considers "healthy," and why it's normal for the number to rise and fall. It's been a recurring topic for Wardogs developer Bulkhead, whose closed beta surpassed 200,000 concurrents today on Steam. Responding to a TimTheTatman clip on X, CEO Joe Brammer spoke on the milsim's unexpected popularity, and its inevitable (but healthy) decline.

"Wardogs will continue to lose players for months as the hype dies down," Brammer wrote . "Doesn't make it a bad game or even a problem, we planned for 5k players concurrent! It'll maintain a healthy playerbase and we'll continue to build the 1.0 version of the game then... it'll boom again :) And so the cycle continues :)"

It's a cycle many of us are familiar with, but rarely acknowledge. I tend to build a rotation of multiplayer favorites that I regularly return to, either to check out an update or scratch an itch. It is, I think, a pretty healthy way to enjoy videogames, but the rise of live service "forever" games, as well as high-profile failures, have proliferated the idea that videogames are those species of shark that will die if they ever stop swimming.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GKVJqE5Xgv69GJmKYusSTc.jpg

Much like the majority of videogames before 2016, Bulkhead does not need Wardogs to be a consistent, top-charting megahit to continue making it. In a video published last month outlining " 10 reasons not to buy Wardogs ," game director Howard Philpott expanded on Bulkhead's expectations:

"We expect our initial days after launch to have a lot more players than expected, but we can tell you for a fact that this is completely normal. Those players will fall away over the next coming months. Player numbers will drop off, and journalists and influencers on the fringe of the community will try to ragebait your enjoyment out of the game for social media clicks. This doesn't mean the game is dying. We're thinking longer term than a flash in the plan. Our goal is to settle into a sustainable, close-knit community. If we're pulling in 3,000 to 5,000 daily concurrent players who genuinely love the game, it'll allow new players to buy in anytime and join an active community."
If we put our hands together on this one, we can all be normal about a multiplayer shooter. Wardogs is out September 10, but pre-ordering grants access to the closed beta ending Sunday.

content.v: 《脑航员2》、《Keeper》开发商Double Fine Productions在脱离Xbox后公布了首款新作《谢谢你，巴士司机》 （Thank You Bus Driver ），这是一款“混乱的巴士驾驶游戏，玩家将扮演一位小镇巴士司机，努力在不违反任何规则的情况下顺利完成一天的工作”。
《谢谢你，巴士司机》将登陆PC平台——Steam、GOG、Humble Store和itch.io购买。目前尚未公布具体发售日期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788563353_626588_jpg_r.jpg
以下是Double Fine Productions提供的游戏概述：
关于这款游戏
《谢谢你，公交车司机》是一款混乱的公交车驾驶游戏，你将扮演一位城镇公交车司机，努力在一天的工作中尽量减少违规行为，并尽可能多地表达你的感激之情……以“谢谢”的形式！
坐到驾驶座上，记住公交车上的三项主要任务：
禁止违反规则
你的巴士，你的规则！谁在乎规则每天都在变?谁在乎车站不断增加新规则?谁在乎有些规则简直就是等着被打破?
没关系！给那些烦人的违规者一巴掌，让他们知道谁才是这条路的主人。如果他们屡犯不改呢?那就从后门取消他们的公交特权。
保持正轨
到达下一站才是最重要的。这可能意味着在转弯途中拿出地图查看路线，也可能意味着抄近路穿过玉米地。至于避开行人、来车或正前方的栅栏，则完全是个人选择。
只要你在乘客生气之前到达下一站，他们肯定不会在意！
按时完成任务
时间紧迫！务必在时间耗尽前到达下一站。记住：只有乘客满意才能给你动力。感谢越多，你到达下一站的时间就越多。
收集更多感谢卡，即可解锁更多巴士小摆件、城镇变体等等！
严格管理公交车，你很可能成为这座城镇有史以来最好的公交车司机。
公交车司机，请记住：维持秩序……但一定要准时到达！

items.title: gamescom 就其对盗窃事件的初步反应道歉，并承诺改进安全措施
items.summary: gamescom has provided a second response regarding the theft of developers’ equipment during its event, offerin

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/gamescom-apologizes-for-initial-response-to-thefts-1788563032796.jpg
gamescom has provided a second response regarding the theft of developers’ equipment during its event, offering an apology for its initial reaction to the ordeal.

On August 28, 2026, indie developer Ryan Laley uploaded a video to X/Twitter claiming that all of his laptops had been stolen at gamescom. He wasn’t the only one affected; several other developers spoke out with similar stories, saying their equipment had also been pilfered at the event.
gamescom responded to the ordeal on August 29, writing that while it was "very sad" about the situation, it "would like to inform [attendees] about general security regulations."

My #gamescom cut short. Our equipment was stolen last night from the booth. Police reports have been filed. At a loss for words to describe the feeling. Just defeated. Gonna do my best with what's left of the week. But a huge blow financially and mentally pic.twitter.com/dKpp3Of6df

"Individual stand security can be booked separately, and exhibitors are advised to insure equipment against theft. This is noted in the terms and conditions of participation and the technical guidelines," it said. "...At an event of this size, however, there will always be individuals attempting to take advantage of the situation. Our security measures are designed to minimize such risks as effectively as possible.”

This statement didn’t go over well. A swath of fellow exhibitors, attendees, and onlookers online felt that gamescom’s reply placed blame on victims of the theft, slamming the event for its "unacceptable response."

Today, September 4, gamescom posted a follow-up statement on social media, in which it apologized for its initial post. It also announced plans to improve security moving forward, promising to host a roundtable discussion with developers who had indie booths at the event.
You can read the statement in full below:

"Over the past few days, we have received a great deal of criticism for the way we communicated about the theft of hardware belonging to several indie developers. That criticism is justified. Our first response did not strike the right tone, and it did not show the people affected the empathy they deserved. We are sorry. A theft like this is far more than a material loss. It can ruin an entire gamescom for the people it happens to, and it can destroy work that took months or years to build - work that, for a small studio, can be almost everything.

"To everyone affected: we understand what this has cost you, and we should have said so from the very first moment. We have already begun talking with those affected - about the theft, about its consequences, and above all to listen. We have also been moved by how this industry responded. Within hours, people offered help - unconditionally, and without being asked. That says a great deal about this community, and we are grateful for it. What it does not do is relieve us, as the organizers, of our own responsibility to work together with our exhibitors and partners to create the best possible environment for everyone.

"We are therefore committed to jointly reviewing and further improving security. Here is what we are doing: Alongside our regular post-event review and our evaluation of exhibitor feedback, we will carry out a dedicated review of security for indie exhibitors. In the coming weeks, we will invite organizers of shared indie booths to a roundtable, so that we can develop concrete measures together.

"We also urge every exhibitor who has experienced an incident to report it - to us and to the police - even if it happened some time ago. Only then can incidents be documented, possible connections between them investigated, and appropriate action taken. You can reach us at sales@gamescom.de . gamescom is made by the industry, for the industry. It lives on the passion of the people who build it, and that includes the many small studios who matter to us enormously. Our commitment has always been to keep making gamescom better - together with the community, not just when things go well. That is exactly what we will do here. Thank you to everyone who is helping us."
pic.twitter.com/lOxBnmMplB

Luckily, several good Samaritans have stepped in to help the developers affected by the thefts in the aftermath. Most notably, The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 developer CD Projekt Red reached out to Laley on social media, promising to "send a few things" his way. Don’t Scream dev Joe Henson, AKA Indie Game Joe, also offered to help out, transforming a tragic situation into a heartwarming show of support and community effort.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

items.title: 万圣节：迄今为止的游戏评论
items.summary: So far this asymmetrical horror game is more trick than treat.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/halloweenthegame-review-blogroll-1788562478441.jpg

Plenty of things are terrifying about a man in a boiler suit creeping up behind you, but it's hard to be scared of Halloween: The Game's Michael Myers when he strolls around the neighborhood with all the urgency of a retiree on a golf course. Admittedly, my early experience with the latest asymmetrical survival horror based on a famous movie came without the obligatory day one patch, so everything I’ve seen so far comes with that giant, flashing caveat. But after several hours, my immediate reaction is that this just isn't ready. I would barely think it’s ready if it were labeled asan early access game, which it’s not. Clumsy, buggy, and often frustrating, Halloween: The Game seems in need of considerable polish and bug squishing.

Developer Illfonic is, of course, almost synonymous with asymmetrical horror at this point, if not quite able to break the stranglehold Behaviour Interactive has with Dead by Daylight. In keeping with the traditions of the genre, you either play on your own as the killer, Michael Myers, and rampage through the town, or you work with up to three other humans and a handful of AI companions to loot items and keep yourself alive long enough to find, open, and escape the streets of Haddonfield on Halloween night in 1978.

Because of Illfonic's back catalog, I came in with high expectations, and knowing Halloween creator John Carpenter was also involved sent them soaring even further. You'd think, with the best part of a decade's learning and all that asym trial and error behind it, Halloween: The Game would be the most polished of all Illfonic's games. But — so far at least — that just doesn't seem to be the case.

Animations are broken or missing completely. I've had hard crashes that sent me back to my PS5 dash, averaging at least one an hour. Combat is beyond janky — several times now, I've stabbed a player and had my weapon phase right through them. Often the sound gets messed up, so when I open a door to my left , I hear it to my right , which is hugely irritating given sound is vital to a stealth horror game. And on two occasions, a quick time event bugged out and trapped me in a broken animation, giving Myers all the time in the world to step up right behind me. That was just as much fun and not-at-all-frustrating as it sounds.

The NPC AI is also hysterically stupid. Once, playing as Myers, I (loudly) busted through a front door and found all three remaining NPCs in the same room, still standing at the same window. I had executed two before the remaining one decided it was time to make a run for it.

It's galling because there are some excellent ideas here. I had a great time with The Texas Chain Saw Massacre 's spin on asymmetrical horror back in 2023, but within days it was clear no one wanted to play as Leatherface because it was so much easier — and considerably more fun — to clock up XP and escape as a survivor.

In Halloween: The Game, however, Illfonic seems to have really worked to balance the odds between killer and civilian, and Myers is a blast to play. Even though he never, ever runs, making it next to impossible to take out a player if they've seen you, his special abilities — snuffing out all the lights in the immediate area; jumping from shadow to shadow; detecting nearby players — help mitigate that deeply unsatisfactory walking speed, especially if you nail the timing. Plus, the execution mechanic is a neat shortcut if you manage to get close enough to… well, execute it. The death animations, if often out of sync, are brilliantly brutal, too, particularly if you manage to catch a civilian, by a window or next to an electric oven. (I'm sure there's more still to discover!)

Best of all, this isn't just four humans against one killer. As Myers, your job is to wipe the map clean of all survivors, human and NPC alike. As a civilian, you need to creep around the deliciously 70s-inspired maps — everything, from the cars to the decor to the rotary phones, is on point here, not to mention the fashion! — quietly warning NPCs and instructing them to either hide, follow you, or escape.

There are plenty of items to gather as you creep through residential homes, including offensive weapons, defensive tools, and a host of goodies to bolster the odds of getting out of there unscathed. You'll never be able to take Myers out completely — just like the movies, this is a dude who does not know how to take the hint and die — but you can temporarily immobilize him with the right timing and the right equipment.

That said, why do we have to sit and watch Myers finish killing off idiot NPCs if all the human players are already dead? You're given QTEs when spectating — I hate them; there are too many, they're too boring, and I swear there's occasionally an input delay — but it's so tedious, especially as the maps are pretty chunky and make hunting down one last survivor time-consuming.

And it just doesn't perform well. Even beyond the poor AI and broken QTEs, I experienced numerous crashes, rubberbanding, and framerate drops for no discernible reason. Characters sometimes walked three feet off the ground. Interacting with items is completely hit-or-miss — half the time you can pick stuff up or remove a chain with a bolt cutter; half the time you cannot. Oh, and sometimes you can open a door, step through it, lock it, and then find yourself back outside the front, unable to get back in.

Like I said, I need to play on the launch patch before finalizing my thoughts — but, generally speaking, a day one update is rarely a miracle fix for all of a review build’s issues. Still, I'll be back once I've spent some time on the live servers with both the single and multiplayer modes (so far the former has completely underwhelmed me — again, mostly due to idiotic NPCs). I'd also like to better understand how the card perk system works and experiment with all the civilians' passive abilities. For now, though, it's difficult to recommend Halloween: The Game to anyone other than a horror fan with a Michael Myers shrine in their home (now that's a scary thought) or those with deep, deep affection for asymmetrical games.

items.title: 《大迁离》科隆展试玩前瞻 非常注重选择和掩体射击
items.summary: 七年前，前BioWare老将James Ohlen在德州奥斯汀创立了Archetype Entertainment ，后来公布了该工作室的首款游戏《大迁离（EXODUS）》。James Ohlen因个人原因离开了Arch

content.v: 七年前，前BioWare老将James Ohlen在德州奥斯汀创立了Archetype Entertainment ，后来公布了该工作室的首款游戏《大迁离（EXODUS）》。
James Ohlen因个人原因离开了Archetype工作室，但《大迁离》的热度依然居高不下，尤其是在《质量效应》粉丝群体中。这款游戏的灵感来源显而易见，Archetype还聘请了原三部曲的著名编剧德鲁·卡皮什恩来创作游戏剧情。此外，整个工作室在游戏设定上也下了很大功夫，甚至邀请彼得·F·汉密尔顿出版了两部小说，并为桌面角色扮演游戏（RPG）爱好者准备了一本游戏手册和其他相关物品。
最终，在2026年科隆游戏展上，我们（外媒WCCF）得以亲身体验这款游戏。当时，发行商威世智和旗下工作室Archetype Entertainment提供了一个长达一个多小时的演示，我们也得以将其录制下来。
目前给人的第一印象就是“《质量效应》”：第三人称掩体射击、队友指挥、技能搭配、角色关系以及道德选择都很有BioWare作品的味道;试玩的战斗和选择系统表现不错，但核心的“时间膨胀”机制尚未充分展示，游戏目前的帧数和优化存在一定问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788561911_613926.webp
试玩总结：
1.试玩任务并非真正的“远征”
本次任务不是跨越数光年的星际远征。
Jun和队伍只是从母星Lidon前往环绕其运行的空间站Khonsu。
Khonsu的护盾负责保护Lidon免受陨石和 太空 碎片威胁，因此战略意义很重要。
2.剧情围绕Gideon控制空间站展开
男主Jun的同父异母兄弟/姐妹Gideon控制了Khonsu。
他还囚禁了当地的觉醒种族Kay，并利用他们为自己办事。
玩家需要解决空间站危机，同时面对Gideon留下的部下。
3.《质量效应》既视感非常强
第三人称视角+掩体射击。
玩家可以直接战斗，也能使用Jun的特殊能力。
队友拥有独立技能，可以由玩家在战斗中指挥。
作者多次将其与BioWare的《质量效应》和《龙腾世纪》进行比较。
4.男主Jun拥有独特的“天神族”力量
Jun拥有特殊的Traveler基因，可以与Celestials遗物互动。
通过探索天神族遗迹，可以获得新的能力。
例如“Petrify（石化）”可以让敌人石化，也能用于探索和解谜。
初期使用的臂铠也能发射强力投射物，并可以获得新的能力。
5.队友系统具有一定战术深度
Elise偏向纯火力输出，拥有导弹类技能。
Suliman则更适合潜行，可以利用Shadowstep瞬移到敌人身后并进行暗杀。
玩家需要根据战斗情况合理安排队友技能，而不是单纯自己射击。
6.选择系统是试玩的一大亮点
玩家遇到受伤的敌方Zealot，可以选择消耗医疗包救他，也可以放任其死亡。
选择支付500马克给一个构造体，获得了25点Paladin点数。
这直接证明游戏存在类似《质量效应》的道德/阵营系统。
某些选择还会影响Jun与队友之间的关系。
7.Kay种族是剧情中的重要元素
试玩中遇到的觉醒者Kay“42C”性格非常搞笑。
他主动跟随玩家，并帮助小队行动。
最终玩家还需要决定是否让Kay保持独立，还是让Suliman所属阵营控制空间站的信标。
这个选择也会影响Suliman与Jun的关系。
8.Boss战和战斗设计比较丰富
试玩中先后面对Zoeller、Lusinchi以及最终Boss级敌人Irina Bruin。
部分敌人需要利用特殊能力和环境机制才能有效对付。
比如Irina Bruin免疫普通弹药，需要诱导她撞向带电柱子，再集中火力攻击。
9.“时间膨胀”仍然没有真正展示
时间膨胀是《大迁离》的核心特色之一。
但由于试玩任务规模有限，作者无法判断这一机制在完整游戏中到底有多大影响。
这也是目前游戏最重要的未知数之一。
10.最大问题是技术表现
试玩版目前存在比较明显的帧数问题。
作者认为游戏的技术打磨程度还有提升空间。
不过试玩时没有开启任何画面重建技术，因此作者希望正式版能够明显改善性能。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260905/1788561957_199382_jpg_r.jpg
外媒WCCF前瞻
我们被派去执行的任务并不是一次“远征（Exodus）”;也就是说，由于游戏中的“时间膨胀”机制，团队并不需要跋涉数光年才能抵达某个遥远的地点，也不会因此产生一系列相应的问题。实际上，这次任务只是从利登（Lidon）前往孔苏（Khonsu）——一座环绕利登运行的空间站，而利登正是主角朱恩·阿斯兰（Jun Aslan）的母星。
这次行动的起因是反派、朱恩的同父异母兄弟/姐妹吉迪恩（Gideon）控制了空间站，并囚禁了当地的凯族（Kay）——一种已经觉醒的青蛙类物种——来为自己办事。
孔苏的战略地位同样十分重要，因为它的护盾能够保护利登免受陨石及其他太空碎片的撞击，因此解决这里的危机也成为了当务之急。
Suliman是小队在Raven阵营中的联系人，也是与Elise一同参与任务的可操作同伴。他已经取得了其中一个补给码头的授权代码，让我们得以悄无声息地降落在Khonsu。不过，Khonsu的自动化安保构造体“幽灵”（Ghosts）很快便向小队发动攻击，这也让我们第一次真正体验到了游戏的战斗系统。
也正是在这里，《大迁离》与《质量效应》的相似之处变得更加明显：这是一款采用第三人称视角、以掩体射击为核心的游戏，而主角Jun还拥有一些特殊能力。在本次试玩中，他使用的是一件源自天神族（Celestials）的臂铠，可以装备不同能力;试玩开始时，它能够发射一种类似长矛的投射物，对敌人造成相当可观的伤害。

随后，试玩版给出了我的第一个真正意义上的选择。一名被“幽灵”重创、遍体鳞伤的狂热者（Zealot）向我们苦苦哀求，希望得到一个医疗包。Suliman立即表示反对，认为我们不应该把资源浪费在敌方士兵身上，哪怕只是一个医疗包也不值得。不过，这名狂热者的遭遇最终打动了我，我还是选择帮助他。他来自Lioness，年幼时因为自己认为的“爱国义务”和一份不错的职业前景而参军，却完全不知道自己最终会被派来镇压一个自己根本没有敌意的种族。他将这一切归咎于那名中尉——对方明明看到了伤亡报告，却依然把他们派了进去。至少在当时看来，眼睁睁看着他独自流血而死，显然不是正确的选择。至于这个决定日后是否会带来实际回报，由于试玩版内容有限，目前还不得而知。
不久之后，我遇到了第一名觉醒者Kay，他简直就是个活宝。他给自己取名为“42C”，显然是一名热衷于收听广播的年轻人，而且正因为如此，他早就听说过Jun的事迹。虽然他无法告诉小队Zealot的首领在哪里，但他还是主动提出帮忙——主要原因似乎只是想亲眼看看战斗。随后，他沿着空间站的输水管道一路跟随小队行动。

items.titleEn: Fury of Dracula (5th Edition) Board Game Review

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/furyofdracula-thumb-1788553359546.jpg

“隐藏运动”类型的棋盘游戏是我的最爱之一，我仍然记得我是在哪里发现这种类型的游戏的。我正在看威尔·惠顿的《桌面》系列，本周的游戏是《德古拉之怒》，在这款游戏中，一个人扮演德古拉的角色，传播恐怖并试图在全球范围内发展他的吸血鬼势力，而其他人则是吸血鬼猎人，试图追踪他并用木桩刺穿他的心脏。尽管爱上了我所看到的东西，但不幸的是，当时《Fury》已绝版，虽然最终我会找到自己的副本，但它仍然是隐藏运动粉丝们相当追捧的游戏。值得庆幸的是，阿瓦隆山的好心人终于在全新的第五版中将其带了回来，世界各地的粉丝可以在下一个棋盘游戏之夜再次追捕德古拉。

对于那些熟悉 Fantasy Flight Games 的第三版或 WizKids 的第四版的人来说，第五版基本上是相同的，但对于其他人来说，《德古拉之怒》是一对多的游戏，一个人扮演伯爵，最多四名其他玩家控制猎人。正如我刚才提到的，这是一款隐藏的移动游戏，德古拉将在地图上移动，将卡片面朝下放置，记录他现在和过去的位置，在他身后留下危险，而猎人则试图诱捕并杀死吸血鬼领主。每轮由白天和夜晚阶段组成，从猎人开始移动、为自己提供工具和特殊活动卡、购买旅行票或寻找目标。白天，这些行动通常更安全，而尝试补给会引发潜在的危险事件，这可能会帮助德古拉。
德古拉的回合没那么重要，但无疑更重要。一旦所有猎人都完成了夜间行动，德古拉就可以移动到新位置，在他们不断增长的踪迹上放置一张面朝下的新位置卡和一张遭遇卡。这些遭遇就像地点本身一样秘密，直到猎人发现它们为止，可能会产生敌人，为猎人带来干扰和延误，甚至更糟。如果其中一个被移出棋盘，即所谓的“成熟”，绝望的轨迹将会增加，让德古拉更接近确保他的胜利！

与其他隐藏动作游戏不同，比如《白厅之谜》（我个人最喜欢的另一款）纯粹是猫捉老鼠的游戏，《德古拉之怒》融入了战斗机制。在猎人将德古拉逼入绝境的情况下，双方都会从手中抽一张牌，由猎人一方的招式或圣弹、手枪等有用物品组成，然后翻转它们，然后解决其效果。尽管这些战斗相当简单，但它也导致了我在棋盘游戏中经历过的一些最紧张的时刻。当误读我的对手时，他们会逃到安全的地方，或者是在一次特别翻盘的时候，我以为距离死亡只有一击的德古拉会逃跑，结果却让他决定咬我并把我击倒。这场失败将绝望的轨道推向了终点，并将胜利交给了德古拉。非常令人气愤，但也是《德古拉之怒》的一个方面，让我觉得它超越了许多其他隐藏动作游戏。

In addition to redone artwork (more on that in a bit), this new fifth edition does offer a couple of optional new elements that can shake up the formula a bit for those Fury vets out there. First is the addition of a fifth hunter to pick from, Jonathan Harker, who previously had been relegated to just an ally card. Mr. Harker now can be picked to replace one of the other hunters, and has some powerful abilities that should certainly help the good guys out. He’s able to not only deal additional damage when hitting Dracula but also, similar to his wife Mina, can force him to announce if Jonathan is in an adjacent spot. While a neat addition, it also feels like a bit of a halfbaked attempt too. Unlike the other hunters, Mr. Harker doesn’t get his own unique event card, and instead can simply use the one made for the hunter that he replaces. The balance of the game also doesn’t quite feel like it’s been balanced for him, and I found that when both Harkers were on the board, with their tracking talents, it made for a decently harder time for Dracula. He’s a fun “sometimes” change, but I plan to stick with my normal squad for most games.

《德古拉之怒》通常是一款需要令人惊讶的时间的游戏，我玩过的一些游戏持续了四个小时以上，而第五版的第二个新功能是更快的游戏模式，可以将时间缩短一半或更多。这个新的更快的变体删除了几张卡牌并封锁了地图上的几个区域（该死的黑死病），同时将棋盘状态设置为大约“一周”后（大约三分之一）的位置，为猎人提供一些开始物品，给德古拉一些伤害，一点绝望，以及一些其他调整。总的来说，我发现这个新变体是一个可靠的选择，并使德古拉之怒成为工作日晚上更可行的选择。较小的区域和其他调整（例如瞬时水流和取消单值火车票）可能会使事情变得更加摇摆，而像德古拉一样逃脱和隐藏起来可能更具挑战性。再说一遍，就像 Harker 一样，它有效，但我很好奇它进行了多少平衡测试。
正如人们对游戏新版本的期望一样，通常不仅是游戏玩法或机制得到更新，而且艺术作品也得到了更新，而这正是第五版最大的不同之处。并不是因为地图发生了变化（尽管在布拉姆·斯托克（Bram Stoker）原版《德古拉》小说的故事中扮演重要角色的惠特比镇最终被包括在内），而是因为审美发生了变化。我认为新版本也正是在这一点上比第三版和第四版倒退了一步。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/furyofdracula-5thed-review2-1788553359543.jpg

除了德古拉的地点卡之外，事件、遭遇、物品和战斗卡的艺术作品都放弃了早期迭代的戏剧性和详细的全彩艺术作品，转而采用我所描述的你可能在旧维多利亚时代报纸上看到的图画。这些黑白插图确实有效，但只是没有产生同样的影响，我敢说，有些甚至有点老套？例如，“黑暗召唤”卡现在的特点是德古拉凝视着月亮，面前有几只蝙蝠，而在早期版本中，德古拉似乎在暴风雨的天空中与​​周围成群的蝙蝠一起晒黑夜。然后是新的“误导”，这基本上使他看起来像动画系列中的蝙蝠侠，而不是一个潜伏在雾中的戴着大礼帽的神秘男子。猎人和德古拉的角色卡也好不了多少，肖像被角色的棕褐色照片所取代。现在我想起来了，你能为德古拉拍一张照片吗？我的意思是，吸血鬼在镜子中没有倒影，所以你能拍摄它们吗？哦，好吧，下次再提问。

content.v: 任天堂即将在下周举行两场直面会，第一场是《塞尔达传说》40周年纪念直面会，时长30分钟，将于北京时间9月8日晚上10点召开。届时可能有几周前泄露的基于该系列40周年纪念的任天堂Switch 2特别版的信息，以及《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》的发售日。

第二场直面会定在9月9日晚上10点，发布会时长约为45分钟。发布会结束后，将立即进行任天堂树屋直播，展示任天堂直面会上部分游戏的实机演示。
《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是2026年少数几款尚未确定具体发售日期的游戏之一。鉴于9月和10月游戏发售档期已满，该作几乎肯定会在11月发售，届时将R星的《GTA6》正面交锋。而且，这场史诗级的游戏对决很可能在下周得到官方确认。

items.title: 免费玩《文明 7》庆祝劳动节
items.summary: There's actually no connection to Labor Day that I can see, but Civ 7 is free to play until September 10, and

content.v: The Labor Day weekend is upon us (in Canada and the US, anyway, and we'll be sure to spare a thought for our UK colleagues who will be working on Monday) and holy cow, it is about time. If you find yourself in need of something to do, here's a thought: Play Civilization 7, because it's free to play on Steam until September 10.

Civ 7's had kind of a rough go of things since it launched in early 2025. It made some big changes to the formula that didn't go over well with a significant portion of the fan base, the UI was almost universally unpopular, and performance was dodgy.

Firaxis has been banging away on it ever since, to mixed results: A major update released in May brought a big bump in player numbers on Steam, but the reactions expressed via Steam reviews were almost literally split down the middle. Civ 7's Steam rating remains "mixed," with only 48% positive user reviews, while concurrent player numbers on the platform are still running neck-and-neck with the 16-year-old Civilization 5.
Civ 5 is much beloved but I imagine Firaxis and Take-Two would like to see people move on.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NRpWH3QdP8YeEwJhSzrYjZ.png

Ah, but here's the counterpoint: It's free . Just go around to Steam and click the "Play Game" button, and after some requisite amount of downloading, you're playing Civ 7 without spending a penny . It's hard to go wrong, really.

If the past year-and-a-half of updates have got Civilization 7 to a point where you think to yourself, 'Yes, I would like to play this game all the time,' you can also pick up the standard and deluxe editions for half price until September 17: That's $35/£30/€35 for the former, and $50/£45/€50 for the latter.
The Civ 7 development team (a small part of it, anyway) will also be discussing what comes next during a livestream from PAX on September 5—you can catch that on YouTube , Twitch , and Facebook .

content.v: 最近有消息称，《GTA6》登陆PC的时间要比我们想象地要更早。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260901/1788224900_271315_jpeg_r.jpeg
VGC记者安迪·罗宾逊爆料，坊间“有一些传言”称，PC版的发售速度可能会出乎意料地快。安迪·罗宾逊谈到主机价格在发售数年后持续上涨，这可能会迫使Take Two在《GTA6》发售不到一年后就会登陆PC。
“我确实认为他们会加快PC版的发售。坊间确实有一些相关的传言。或许正是因为目前种种原因，PC版才会提前发售。”
上一作《给他爱5》于2013年9月17日首发，登陆了PS3和Xbox 360， 1年零7个月（19个月）后，即2015年4月才登陆了Windows PC。
许多玩家虽然没有新一代主机，但有PC，而借助NVIDIA DLSS和AMD FSR等技术，即使在配置稍低的电脑上，《GTA6》也能流畅运行。

items.title: “侠盗猎车手是一款围绕犯罪活动打造的视频游戏系列”：迈阿密戴德县治安官强烈反对 GTA 6 与 Rockstar 合作的提议
items.summary: It actually sounds like a really good idea, but of course the cops are against it.

content.v: Officials with Miami-Dade County have held talks with Rockstar about using facilities and landmarks in the county to promote the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 , according to a recent report by The Miamian , saying it could represent "a unique opportunity to generate revenue for the County while showcasing Miami-Dade to a massive audience." Just one problem: the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office is dead-set against it.

The Miamian report (via RPS ) says the county submitted a pitch deck to Rockstar on June 29, after which staff had "some conversations with Rockstar about potential opportunities around the launch of GTA 6," said Carlos Suarez, a spokesperson for Miami-Dade Mayor Daniella Levine Cava.

"Nothing has been formally agreed to or approved, and any idea would have to go through the appropriate review and approval process," Suarez said. "Given Miami-Dade's clear influence on the game, we think there could be a unique opportunity to generate revenue for the County while showcasing Miami-Dade to a massive audience."

Miami-Dade is the inspiration for Vice City in the GTA series, and by "inspiration" I mean it basically is Vice City, although Miami exists as a separate city in the game's fiction. Vice City will serve as a central location in GTA 6, and will represent the seat of Vice-Dale County, much as the city of Miami is the county seat of Miami-Dade. Given that, the campaign makes obvious sense, and most of the ideas floated don't sound too overly disruptive.
Some examples:
The pitch also includes ideas for Rockstar funding permanent upgrades to county infrastructure:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8HzehPMbGVAYdPjAGozvg5.jpg

That all sounds pretty cool to me, and some of it is quite civically wholesome, too. Yes, it's all part of the monstrous marketing machine for the biggest videogame of all time, but it also seems like the county is coming at it as a way to celebrate the real people and civic culture that led Rockstar to embrace Miami in the first place, and that counts for something.
The big stumbling block, of course, is that the GTA games are the polar opposite of civic-minded and wholesome, and that's led Miami-Dade Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz to speak out against the idea.

"Grand Theft Auto is a videogame franchise built around criminal activity," Cordero-Stutz told the Miami Herald . "Its fictional world includes murder, robbery, drug trafficking, carjacking, violence against law enforcement, and other conduct that the men and women of the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office work every single day to prevent."

Miami-Dade Commissioner Juan Carlos Bermudez also spoke out against the idea: "We should be promoting the Miami-Dade we have worked so hard to build, not a fictional version of our community defined by crime and violence."

The sheriff isn't wrong. GTA games have always been notoriously violent: Former attorney Jack Thompson , at one time the videogame industry's foremost nemesis, spent years campaigning hard against the games and publisher Take-Two Interactive before he was finally disbarred for his relentless antics and misconduct.

But the game industry, and its audience, have matured in the 25 years (that's right, look it up) since Grand Theft Auto 3 changed everything: GTA is still steeped in criminal violence, but the shock factor—and the hand-wringing over it—are long gone. These days it's completely mainstream, as evidenced by the performance of the GTA 6 reveal showcase on Netflix, which was the platform's biggest show of the week.

Would Miami-Dade have to tone down some of the seedier elements of GTA 6 for its "family appropriate" events? Sure. But I also have no doubt that a significant number of sheriff's deputies and police in the county grew up playing GTA themselves, and I bet an awful lot of them will be calling in sick when GTA 6 drops.

items.title: 在 2021 年大规模扩建办公室后，Bungie 目前正尝试转租其 211,000 平方英尺的总部
items.summary: Bungie says it "will continue to maintain a physical office presence in Bellevue."

content.v: In 2021, as studio CEO Pete Parsons cited the company's recent "tremendous growth and opportunity," Bungie announced its plans for a massive expansion to its Bellevue, Washington headquarters . The campus embiggening, which internal sources have reportedly described as costing "hundreds of millions" of dollars, more than doubled the size of Bungie's offices from 84,000 square feet to just under 211,000.

Now, after five and a half years of spending sprees, publisher acquisitions, stumbling product launches, project cancellations, and repeated mass layoffs, Bungie appears to be seeking subletters for the goliath game development headquarters it's no longer capable of filling.

According to a 10-page leasing brochure reviewed by The Game Post , Bungie is seeking interested renters to sublease its expansive headquarters, listing its 210,984 square feet as a "turn-key" production facility. In addition to expected office fixtures, the listing also features a dedicated lobby, gym and exercise facilities (including a rock climbing wall), a motion-capture studio, a cafe, catering space, and a private exterior patio.
While the brochure didn't directly identify the studio, a statement provided to press verified that Bungie was actively pursuing a sublease.

"Bungie is exploring options to sublease its campus in Bellevue, Washington. The studio transitioned to a digital-first model several years ago, and this move reflects the team's evolving workplace needs and the effectiveness of its remote collaboration," Bungie said. "Bungie will continue to maintain a physical office presence in Bellevue."

Bungie formally adopted remote work eligibility for most of its roles in 2022, following the studio's shift to work-from-home development during the COVID-19 lockdown years—effectively defeating the purpose of its office expansion due to circumstances that would have been impossible to predict during its early planning stages.

Bungie wasn't the only games company to make ill-fated investments during the height of the pandemic: Analysts have repeatedly cited overly-ambitious expansions and acquisitions—propelled by the COVID era's low interests rates and explosion of at-home entertainment revenue—as one of the driving forces behind the games industry's brutal cost-cutting in the years that followed.

Bungie's overextension, however, was particularly drastic. After Sony purchased the studio for $3.6 billion in 2022 , Bungie leadership embarked on a rampant hiring spree, adding hundreds of developers to the payroll to fill out development teams for a swath of simultaneous incubation projects—projects that would prove unsustainable as the impact of Covid waned and revenues started to tumble across the industry.

A mass layoff followed in October 2023 , affecting roughly 100 employees. The next round cut 220 developers in July 2024 as fallout from Bungie leadership having reportedly "overstated their studio’s financial prospects to Sony," leading to a dire enough fiscal outlook that even the success of Destiny 2's Final Shape expansion couldn't salvage it. As Sony intensified its oversight amidst the mounting turmoil, Bungie's leadership began to abandon ship, culminating with Pete Parsons departing the studio in 2025—presumably in one of his vintage collector cars .

Bungie staff ultimately suffered another sweeping layoff in June 2026, with most of the Destiny team losing their jobs in the aftermath of Destiny 2's end of live service. At peak employment, Bungie's staff numbered over 1,600; in July 2024, Parsons said the studio numbered around 850 . The WARN notice issued for this June's layoff indicated at least 292 jobs were affected.
In other words, if all of Bungie's remaining employees gathered in its office, there would be fewer than 600 people to fill its 211,000 square feet.
If you're interested, the master lease runs through September 30, 2035.

items.title: 白宫推出了在线“街机”，其中有自己的俄罗斯方块和其他流行游戏，但它和你想象的一样糟糕
items.summary: The arcade currently includes games based on Tetris, Flappy Bird, and Snake, and of course a healthy dose of r

content.v: The White House, the epicenter of power in the most powerful nation in human history, has rolled out a new online arcade on its website. And yes, it is every bit as racist, repugnant, and creatively bankrupt as you'd expect.

We'll set aside the question of "why?" for now and get straight to the games, beginning with Flappy Bill, a game in which you fly a bald eagle down the National Mall. It's not clear whether the bird's name is actually Bill because it's also carrying a bill, which my young years of being exposed to Schoolhouse Rock from across the border taught me is part of the US lawmaking process, or at least used to be before they decided that having the president do everything by fiat is more efficient or something. In any event, it's an entirely unremarkable Flappy Bird clone, innocuous but about as much fun as tying a shoelace.

The tone takes a hard turn to the right with the next game, Build the Wall: Zombie Border Siege, a Tetris knock-off where you'll "protect the border from the coming horde." To ensure there's no misunderstanding the nature of this horde, the game's backdrop is a retro-future take on the sun setting over a barren desert—and in case that's too subtle, there's also a sign that says "Southern Border."

One notable thing about this one is that unlike actual Tetris, the lines don't disappear when they're completed. Instead, they just stack up until they reach the top, at which point it's inevitably game over no matter how neatly you've arranged things. A slow-moving line of "zombies" moves across the bottom of the screen, and they are capable of getting past your wall if you haven't built it high enough—but "high enough" is literally two stacked tetrominoes, after which nothing can get past. So I'm not sure what the point is there, except to be really racist and xenophobic, I suppose.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4cqz6PSMDtuDVvDK8LEGy5.png

Moving on: The third game in the White House Arcade is called Rio Run, a recreation of a "border patrol along the Rio Grande" based on the ancient classic Snake. As a balding white guy in a suit, you pick up brown-skinned people one at a time, each of whom joins a train behind you wearing shackles and an orange jumpsuit. Once the game ends, when you run into a wall or your train of prisoners, they're all deported and you're encouraged to try again. Lovely.

I don't really know what to make of the fourth game. Supply Line, as it's called, charges you to "sort the school line to make America healthy again" by letting 'good' food ride a conveyor belt to the school lunch box, while chucking 'bad' food—anything with coloring, additives, sealed packages, or seed oils—into the "reject" box.

This one was a little tricky at first because the low-effort graphics make it difficult to tell good food from bad (as the concept is envisioned by Robert F. Kennedy Jr), but what's really bizarre is the muscular Black man in boxing gloves standing in the background. Every time I let a bad bit of food slip past, he punched the back of my monitor. Four punches and it was game over, although oddly enough he's the one who took the actual damage.
Also, reading labels is apparently bad, according to a sign with a red strike through it. Ain't that America? For you and me, baby.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MVjJJ3wUc2bDp2X83dVGh5.png

The fifth and final game on the White Hours Arcade tour is Trump Savings Tycoon, a game about filling your kids' Trump Accounts , which are basically retirement savings accounts for children, backed by money from various super-wealthy individuals like Jensen Huang and Michael Dell who may or may not have anything to gain from big-money sycophancy.

This game involves simply clicking on various money-esque objects with a net as they fly across the sky. It's maybe the simplest of the bunch mechanically, but the clicking is extremely imprecise so it doesn't take long before three objects are missed and it's game over.

More interesting to me is the background, which features the Reflecting Pool (a perfectly lovely shade of blue, unlike its real-world counterpart ) and a massive construction crane looming over the Washington DC skyline, presumably indicating optimism about the president's planned ballroom/bunker. There's also a small convoy of what appears to be flying police cars that goes soaring across the sky every now and then. I have no theories about what that might be about.

In case it wasn't sufficiently clear, these things are universally bad, both conceptually and in execution: If you're going to rip off the world's most famous stacking game to promote your racist agenda, for instance, you should at least make it play like that game. It's an astonishingly lazy effort, and I can't shake the feeling that all of these games were vibe-coded, maybe by some DOGE hanger-on they found hiding in the bathroom.

The obvious question is, as noted earlier, is why? Who are these games for? I think the answer in one sense is that they're for no one in particular, but are instead just another wave in the flood of sewage pumped out every day by the US president and his administration. Over the last couple years, the US government has posted numerous gaming-related memes , video clips , and AI generated images to promote its leader and his agenda.
But more broadly, this effort is targeted at the young male gamer demographic, at least in part to leverage the political influence it first demonstrated during the Gamergate harassment campaign.

George E. Osborn, author of Power Play: Videogames, Politics, and the Battle for Global Influence , wrote on his Videogames Industry Memo blog (via The Guardian ) that "the content works because it does what a lot of good social content does. It riffs on widely known popular culture to get cut through in the way many popular memes do. It has a chaotic, anarchic tone which suits the channel it's in. It is transgressive in a way that delights the administration's supporters and infuriates its rivals. And it feels all the more edgy because the formerly stuffy White House social channels have been turned into a place where this kind of stuff circulates freely.

"A big chunk of the modern political right in America emerged from Gamergate. The hate movement was brought into the political fold by Steve Bannon and Breitbart after it showed how it is possible to wash extreme talking points into the mainstream political environment. Its members became online 'shock troopers' for Trump, as well as becoming foundational figures in the alt-right and nuttier fringes like QAnon. And as they've grown up, the almost entirely young men who made waves back in 2014 are now in positions of power on the right. This allows them to shape the online narrative, encouraging them to reach a fresh generation of men through an increasingly fragmented social media ecosystem that allows transgressive macho 'manosphere' content to trend."

The US government shows no sign of easing off on these behaviors. Posts on X promoting the new arcade site include animations using the Xbox, Nintendo, and Sega logos, the latter of which was probably chosen because it morphs well into "MAGA."

items.title: 特朗普政府推出“建墙”克隆游戏后俄罗斯方块做出回应
items.summary: Official Tetris pages have responded after the Trump administration launched a clone video game called 'Build

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2019/03/18/tetris-1552946351175.jpg
Official Tetris pages have responded after the Trump administration launched a clone video game called 'Build the Wall.'

The Tetris Company joined the backlash after Donald Trump's White House published its Arcade.Gov website today. Amongst a line of games on offer, which includes a Flappy Bird clone called 'Flappy Bill' and a Snake clone called 'Rio Run,' is Build the Wall.
A description for the game follows: "Protect the border from the coming horde." It's a message that Tetris wants absolutely nothing to do with.

"At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and bringing people together, not dividing them," it said. "To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

Tetris continued, confirming that it had nothing to do with the Trump administration's Build the Wall game. It also added, "We take copyright infringement very seriously." The Tetris Company does not seem to have taken any sort of legal action against the arcade page yet.

The White House launched its website yesterday. It contains five games, including titles asking players to "border patrol along the Rio Grande" and "fill your kids' Trump accounts." It also warned that more games are coming soon.

Arcade.Gov immediately faced backlash from users online. Many have called on companies pulled from the site's reveal video, including Tetris and Sega, to take action. Although the latter has yet to chime in, Tetris is being quite vocal – and so are its fans. Some of its statement's top comments note that games such as this are typically about breaking walls, not building them. Others are just happy to see Tetris speaking up.
CAN'T STOP WINNING. 🎮 Build the wall. Deport. Fill a Trump Account. LIVE - PLAY NOW 📲 https://t.co/qIR69AxSnm pic.twitter.com/2nr2jG1ZRg

The Tetris Company's Kerri Brusca also provided The Verge with a statement on the matter: "For more than 40 years, Tetris has brought people together across generations and cultures through play and joy. The objective of the game has always been to stack with purpose to clear as many lines as possible. We are currently reviewing the matter."

IGN reported on the site's original launch earlier today. The Trump administration has stirred controversy with similar moves in the past, including posts referencing the Halo series . Although Microsoft was silent on that matter, The Pokémon Company and Master Chief actor Steve Downes are amongst those who have spoken up .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: 我：您现在可以在 AMD GPU 上运行 DLSS 5。我的 RX 9070 XT：请停下来，这伤害了我们
items.summary: A new app allows you to inject DLSS Neural Rendering deep into games even if you're running an AMD card. You p

content.v: Another day, another DLSS 5 story that actually kinda doesn't involve Nvidia itself doing anything, because it seems now AMD GPU owners can get in on the act. A new homebrew app has been released on Github that will allow you to run the DLSS Neural Rendering feature on a Radeon GPU. I've tried it and it works, but damn does it hurt the poor Radeon silicon.

From having DLSS 5 .dll files plucked from an early access version of NBA 2K27, we've had modders working hard to create surprisingly polished ways to essentially get the tech working in practically any game , even if it doesn't natively support traditional DLSS itself.

I've been playing around with it a lot this past week, even to the point of jamming it into Football Manager 26 just to see what would happen. And, y'know what, I kinda like the result so I'm keeping it. I wasn't expecting that, and I also wasn't expecting this technology, created by Nvidia, to appear so quickly on AMD GPUs. Historically we've found that where Nvidia goes, so AMD follows, at least in the GPU feature space, but it seems like AMD might not actually have to do much this time. Well, apart from actually make the silicon a little more tensor-friendly.

Because I have spent the afternoon trying to get the new app from user danielblnc on Github to work on my Radeon RX 9070 XT in Cyberpunk 2077. Essentially you download the DLSS-NR-on-AMD file, drop it into the relevant folder (the bin/x64 folder in the Cyberpunk 2077 directory in Steam, for example) and run it. So long as you have the necessary nvngx_dlssnr.dll file that's been doing the rounds installed in the same place it ought to work.
It didn't.

Initially Windows flagged it as containing a virus, but I did some checking around with VirusTotal and seemingly the Defender flag is a machine learning false positive. Probably. But even then I still struggled to have it running happily.

I am not entirely sure what I did wrong, but when I enabled the feature in-game all I got was a black output where the 3D world ought to be, even though the HUD and game kept on running. After some file deletion, redownloading, verifying of integrity (mine and Cyberpunk's), and a rollback of my AMD Adrenalin drivers, I finally got it working. Kinda. I mean it's still kinda crashy, and I can only now launch Cyberpunk 2077 directly from the .exe file rather than from Steam, but it works.

But my poor GPU wished I hadn't. Now, we know that DLSS 5 is a hell of a resource hog on an RTX 50-series GPU that it's designed for, with a touted 50 - 60% performance hit officially noted by Nvidia , so I should have known it would trouble the AMD GPU.
DLSS NR on Nvidia
DLSS 5 was designed for GeForce GPUs, so is a little more capable, but still a massive resource hog.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/B3ULyP68EiAPD55fRNR8S7.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HY5MBFRknD6or3SV8M3eP7.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bkwSqn4ocKYaQwBeFt2HHb.png

Still… running at 4K RT Ultra settings is tough enough, and I was getting just 61 fps on the RX 9070 XT even with FSR 4 set to Balanced. And then flicking the DLSS Neural Rendering toggle to 'on' made that figure drop to just 9 fps.
And I thought the 73% drop Andy found with NBA 2K27 was rough.
DLSS NR on AMD
AMD GPUs running DLSS 5 looks great, but runs horribly.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GdUR8M8koZZwGPhmTxDmN8.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FqdP8wjrhsx4LHcLV63wH8.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bkwSqn4ocKYaQwBeFt2HHb.png

Now it's worth noting that the fact it is running at all on AMD GPUs is impressive on its own, but it's not going to make any Radeon graphics card owners any happier about it when they're getting unplayable frame rates out of their new ill-gotten pretties. An 85% performance drop is not sustainable. Nice for screenshots though, eh?
The issue is that AMD's RDNA 4 doesn't have the level of dedicated silicon for the sort of matrix calculations the feature is running… in the same way that RTX 20-series chips don't.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/izPy8MckiwADhpps9hdzR8.jpg

The Turing architecture does have Tensor Cores, but they're far weaker compared to those in the RTX 40- or RTX 50-series, and the shared resources AMD plucks from the standard RDNA 4 Compute Units for these sorts of calculations aren't as robust either. Hence the weaker performance.

Will they be able to squeeze more performance out of this feature on AMD chips? I don't know, but YouTuber Ancient Gameplays noted the app in a recent video, and states that performance has gone up 12% since the first version of the DLSS-NR-on-AMD software first hit Github, so maybe there's a chance. But, realistically, I think there's a hard hardware limit in there which is going to stop DLSS Neural Rendering from being a realistic part of AMD's armoury in this generation.

items.title: Rockstar 审查《侠盗猎车手 6》中国版加长版预告片
items.summary: Rockstar Games has published a heavily censored version of the Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look reveal for Chi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta-6-gameplay-blog-1787861652027.jpg
Rockstar Games has published a heavily censored version of the Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look reveal for China.

As shared by @videotech on X/Twitter , the studio behind the game that is convincing publishers to steer clear of November published its 27-minute gameplay reveal on Chinese social media platform Bilibili last week – but some things are just a bit different from other uploads (via Kotaku ). It doesn't take long to realize that large portions of the GTA 6 trailer have been blurred out, including dancing, drug-related content, and sexual content.

Considering this is a Grand Theft Auto game, there's quite a bit you can't see. Footage of protagonists Jason and Lucia at a nightclub, for example, basically turns the screen into a giant purple blur. A later scene blurs out Jason's hand when he's smoking, while brief shots of the beach censor some of the crowd. While most corpses seem unblurred, footage showing close-ups of bloodied dead bodies has also been completely censored.

It's a very different look at GTA 6, but the video wasn't originally the blurry mess we see here. As spotted by GTAForums user BDF , this reportedly isn't the same video Rockstar originally uploaded following GTA 6: Extended Look's Netflix premiere.
The first upload supposedly didn't have the same censoring it does now. Rockstar is said to have altered the video around August 31. The reasoning behind the delayed adjustments is unclear.

BDF noted that the changes have split users on China's Reddit-like platform, Tieba, and other online communities. While some suspect Rockstar censored GTA 6 to keep younger users from viewing the trailer's contents, others believe the move reflects prejudice from Rockstar and parent company Take-Two Interactive. BDF also reported that Rockstar and Take-Two have issued DMCA takedowns for those reposting unblurred content on Bilibili.

Censored or not, the floodgates for GTA 6 seem to officially be open ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X | S. New Vice City-themed PS5 controllers were revealed just yesterday, additional screenshots were posted on Rockstar's website earlier this week, and fans are still combing through every detail from last week's big gameplay reveal .
There will surely be plenty more to show before that release date finally rolls around. Until then, you can see IGN's coverage, including our preview and interview with the team at Rockstar.

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: 即将推出的 Nintendo Switch 2 游戏：2026 年及以后的发布日期
items.summary: Building up the Switch 2 library.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/01/23/switch2games-1769208267817.jpg
We now have our hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 , a new console from one of the biggest names in gaming. Alas, a new console is only as valuable as the library of games you can build on it.

Thankfully, Nintendo hasn't been shy about planned releases over the next year. In the second half of 2026, we'll be getting our hands on a mix of Switch 2 exclusives, third-party releases, and the benefit of backward compatibility with any games still launching on the original Switch. Without further ado, here are all of the new Switch 2 games we can look forward to in 2026 and beyond.
All Upcoming Switch 2 Games With Release Dates
* indicates a Switch 2 exclusive
Mewgenics (September 8, 2026)

From the same creator as The Binding of Isaac, which is also making its way to Switch 2 later in the year, Mewgenics is a turn-based strategy game that’s all about breeding cats and battling nasty things. We gave it a very solid 9/10 when it first launched on PC earlier this year, saying it's "good for more than a hundred hours of roguelike runs." It also has some very catchy music.
The Switch 2 edition of Mewgenics will also be getting a physical cartridge release at some point in early 2027.
RuneScape: Dragonwilds (September 15, 2026)
RuneScape got a bit of a makeover with this new open world crafting and survival game that was initially released last year, and is finally coming to Switch 2 this fall.
Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave (September 17, 2026)*

We finally have a release date for the next game in the Fire Emblem series, which already happens to be available to preorder . Here’s a snippet of what to expect from the official Nintendo listing : “Worthy fighters from all over the land have come to Dagsion, the capital city of the Dagdan Empire, to compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to win one wish. Among the combatants are four heroes tied to the fate of the world.” You can learn more about how the game balances those four heroes in our hands-on preview .
Trine 6: Together in Time (September 17, 2026)

If you’re looking for a cozy platformer you can play with a friend, Trine 6 might have you covered. The latest side-scrolling sequel from FrozenByte is designed with co-op in mind, so you can test your friendship on movement combos and puzzles.
Another Eden Begins (September 17, 2026)

From Masato Kato, the writer behind Chrono Trigger, comes Another Eden Begins, a completely fresh RPG that takes you on a journey across the past, present, and future. Recruit companions from a roster of 18 characters to help you take down the Beast King and find your sister. This one’s got a whopping 10 endings on the menu, though I’m sure some of those are reserved for New Game+.
LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight (September 18, 2026)

The latest LEGO game finally has a Switch 2 release date. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is truly next level . It blends and parodies classic Batman moments from across all iterations of the caped crusader while also offering a pretty massive plastic version of Arkham to play around in. Even the combat is pretty elaborate, with inspiration from the Arkham games courtesy of development support from Rocksteady Studios.
SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance (September 24, 2026)

SEGA brought back its Shinobi series with the action platformer Art of Vengeance in 2025. We called the new release “a genuinely engaging 2D action platformer that’s beautiful to behold and even better to play” in our review , and it’ll be getting a Switch 2 port later this year.
Minecraft Dungeons II (September 29, 2026)

We called the first Minecraft Dungeons game a “fun dungeon crawler with a simple but tried-and-true set of systems.” The sequel, developed by Mojang and published by Xbox, will be launching across platforms, including Switch 2, this September . Like the first game, the block-based dungeon crawler will support both local and online multiplayer.
007 First Light (September 30, 2026)

Yet another massive multi-platform release, IO Interactive's take on James Bond is launching on Switch 2 several months after its initial release on PC, PS5, and Xbox in late May. The game lets you play out Bond's initial recruitment and rise in the MI6 ranks, featuring Patrick Gibson as the titular spy and Lenny Kravitz as the villain Bawma .
Octopath Traveler I & II - Switch 2 Editions (October 1, 2026)

Following the release of Octopath Traveler 0 , Square Enix is releasing fresh Switch 2 editions of the original two games that defined the HD-2D style. We were big fans of both, for what it’s worth, with IGN’s Seth Macy praising how the first game “pushes JRPGs forward rather than simply paying homage to the greats” in his 9/10 review .
Rayman Legends Retold (October 1, 2026)
Remakes truly are all the rage right now. This one is a 3D reimagining of 2013’s Rayman Legends, which we called a “work of platforming genius” in our original 9.5/10 review .
Kingdom Hearts Collection [I~III] (October 8, 2026)

The Switch 2 will be getting fresh editions of existing Kingdom Hearts games, which will replace the existing ‘ Cloud streaming’ versions that were available on the Switch. Those Cloud versions were notoriously… not great, so here’s to hoping this gives everyone a better shot at the series ahead of Kingdom Hearts 4 . The three collections will be available individually or as one big bundle.
Hell is Us (October 8, 2026)

Hell is Us, from studio Rogue Factor, was originally released almost exactly year ago. In the words of our review , the game “has a blend of exploration, puzzles, and combat that, while familiar, pushes you to really pay attention to the world around you in a way that’s both compelling and occasionally frustrating."
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen (October 9, 2026)

Capcom’s RPG sequel is getting a new ‘Dark Arisen’ edition with fresh content and QOL improvements as it launches on the Switch 2. Jarrett Green reviewed the game for IGN when it was first released on PC, saying that it’s more than anything “a retelling and reimplementation of… wonderful ideas from the 2012 cult-classic.”
The Witch’s Bakery (October 14, 2026)

For the cozy gamers, The Witch’s Bakery places you in control of Lunne, a young witch who’s opening a new bakery in Paris. In the vein of something like Dave the Diver, each in-game day is split into multiple phases of managing your bakery and exploring the town while also using your magic to help your friends.
Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse (October 15, 2026)

The first 2D Castlevania game in almost 20 years narratively follows Castlevania 3: Dracula’s Curse, taking place a little over decade after that one’s story (which also serves as inspiration for the animated Netflix series). Mitchell Saltzman got the chance to preview the game for IGN , with particular praise for the combat, saying there’s “plenty of room to carve out your own personal playstyle thanks to the variety of weapons, Arcana, and relics.”
Tales of Eternia Remastered (October 16, 2026)

Tales of Eternia is getting a remake and returning to its original title. Previously localized as Tales of Destiny II in North America, Eternia was first released for the PS2 back in the 2000 as the third game in Namco’s Tales series.

items.title: Xbox 版 GTA 6：仅今天即可节省 10 美元
items.summary: Xbox owners can save $10 on Grand Theft Auto 6's ultimate edition using this simple workaround (but it's only

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/untitled-design-1788544409551.png

Here’s a good deal for any Xbox Series X|S owner who hasn’t preordered Grand Theft Auto 6 yet. Today only, by taking advantage of an Xbox gift card deal at Newegg , you can effectively knock $10 off the price of GTA 6.

How does it work, you ask? Newegg is offering $5 off $50 Xbox gift cards if you enter promo code LDSF373 at checkout . Thankfully, the code stacks, so you can add two gift cards to your cart to get $10 off $100 worth of credit.

As luck would have it, the ultimate edition of GTA 6, the one most people are buying , is available to preorder on Xbox for $99.99 . Put it all together, and you effectively save $10 off GTA 6. But remember, the deal is good today only.

Why preorder GTA 6 at all? It can be safely assumed that the game will carry a massive file size. If you preorder, you can preload it starting November 12 , a week ahead of launch. That way it’ll be installed on your system and ready to play the moment it comes out.

We had only gotten a sprinkling of specifics about GTA 6 over the past few years until last week’s extended look blew the game open with 27 minutes of frankly awesome-looking gameplay footage. I was expecting it to look incredible, but it actually exceeded my expectations. Games like this don’t come around often.
IGN’s own Rachel Weber got to see a lot more than those 27 minutes of the game, and also got to chat with the co-studio head Rob Nelson about it. Check out her preview for a ton of new GTA 6 info.

Personally, I’ve been debating which console to play GTA 6 on , and I’m leaning toward Xbox, so I think I’m going to take advantage of this gift card deal. I like the Xbox controller better (though the Wolverine PS5 controller looks pretty stellar), and I’m also a big fan of the Quick Resume function. But really, I imagine it’ll play just fine on both consoles.

I posted a similar deal for PS5 yesterday, but that one has ended, just as this one will end at midnight tonight. However, even if you missed out, all hope is not lost. GTA 6 doesn’t come out until November 19, and Newegg offers discounts on PlayStation and Xbox gift cards fairly often. I’d say it’s likely this deal will come back around before the big launch.
