items.title: DLSS 5 毕竟会出现在较旧的显卡上
items.summary: On Nvidia's forums, an Nvidia employee claimed that the company will be expanding DLSS 5 support to RTX 40 ser

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/23/jensen-gpu-1774306276198.png
Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering tech officially debuted yesterday in NBA 2K27, and it's only supported on current-generation RTX 5000 graphics cards. But it seems like that'll change over time.

On Nvidia's forums, an employee claimed that the company will be expanding DLSS 5 support to RTX 40 series graphics cards at some point, but we're probably going to wait a while for it. He said, "Our current focus is on optimizing performance for the GeForce RTX 50 Series with model updates expected later this fall," but noted that "once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series."

So, it seems like the company's focus, at least for now, is to get it running smoother on current-generation graphics cards before retrofitting it to its Ada Lovelace architecture. That makes a lot of sense, too. I've briefly messed around with the technology in NBA 2K27, and I was surprised by how subtle the changes were, at least compared to some of the nightmare fuel I've seen on Reddit. But even though the technology did make NBA 2K27 look better, it had a massive impact to performance, and I was testing it on an RTX 5090 .

Turning on DLSS 5 on my main system brought the pre-frame-gen frame rate down from around 57-60 fps down to around 37 fps, a pretty massive 43% performance drop. If that's the performance hit on the most powerful graphics card on the market, I'm not confident about how well something like the RTX 4080 would handle it, especially with its older Tensor Cores.

It's clear that Nvidia has made a lot of headway in optimizing the technology since it was first revealed back in March, though. Back then, Nvidia needed two RTX 5090s to even run it, and now Team Green claims that it has improved model performance by around 5x. There's a possibility that with enough optimization, the performance hit will shrink over time. But, until I actually see that, I'm going to remain skeptical.
Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

items.title: 《黎明行者之血》结局以及如何获得每个结局
items.summary: Decide the fate of Vale Sangora and free Coen's family.

content.v: It took me quite a while to work out all The Blood of Dawnwalker endings . Similar to The Witcher 3, there are a fair few different options, each with a number of variables that can change based on your choices. There are also some secret endings to discover.
Obviously, this guide will contain spoilers for just about everything, you've been warned. Here's each ending, how they work, plus a short explainer about the epilogue and its different outcomes.
All Blood of Dawnwalker endings
There are seven possible endings to Blood of Dawnwalker.
Also two additional notes:

All endings, except for one of the secret ones, involve an epilogue sequence which runs through decisions you made throughout the game—and there are some big differences, but I'll explain all of those in the epilogue section at the end if you're curious. Side note, make sure to have 800 Denarius on hand for any ending involving the epilogue , as the church will ask for a donation and you can give your sister Yanna a dowry.
Assaulting Griefberg Castle
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UyPkx27rQ7fixw27odnigB.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/29Qdjrf6oG9ewXLgpiHtMH.jpg
Four of the game's endings begin with assaulting Griefberg Castle, and in every version, your assault changes based on a few key variables:
Below, I'll run through each variation of the castle assault.
A Lone Wolf's Hunt
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dKoM7QXNMeePjoNQUU5xvc.jpg
Coen takes the fight to Brencis by himself.

Shadow Step over the wall of Griefberg Castle at nighttime. Or find Father Florin's hideout in Svartrau cathedral, track him down, and complete A Hero's End, which unlocks the ability to enter the castle in the day using a password at a sidedoor.

This ending sees Coen assault Griefberg Castle by himself at either day or night, depending on which of the above you approach. If you do fight Ambrus, Bakir, or Xanthe, you won't be able to drink their Vrakhir blood and gain their abilities if it's daytime, or invite them in, and will instead just kill them.

First off, you always have to fight the Unblinking Blasphemy boss, even if you completed the Who Pulls the Strings quest for the Manumits. You battle through the castle, free some prisoners by unlocking their cells, and eventually confront Brencis in the dungeon depths, just in time to save your family.

You can either fight Brencis here, or make a deal with him if you agree to bow and give up either Crake and the Manumits, or Lacra, though if it's the former, you'll have to go their hideout and mark it, as in the A Deal With the Devil ending (I'll explain that one in its dedicated section below).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WJz3i3DkaqLVSK5p9vNctc.jpg

If not, you'll fight and defeat Brencis, and choose whether to invite him in, or leave him in Anachora (vampire hell) to have his soul devoured. After this, the epilogue sequence in Laslea will begin.

This is genuinely one of my favorite endings—Vale Sangora becomes independent and there's some degree of lawlessness, but the Manumits protect the valley from the worst enterprising ruffians. You can read a proclamation on a tree in Laslea explaining that Svatrau city council plans to petition Bohemia, Hungary, or Poland to join their realms in the spring.

Since there are no more Vrakhiri, the plague returns, the Uriashi return to their villages, but Christianity also returns, the cathedral is restored, and Father Florin becomes a saint. I'm sure you're thinking " That's a good ending??" but just wait until I explain the others.
Rise At Dawn, Fall Before Dusk
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4fRTiVosLRDw2tSSKk8cqH.jpg
Coen helps Crake and the Manumits restore Catalin Dragosti to power.
Join the Manumits via The Firebrand, Shadows in the Woods, and Where Loyalty Lies , and then follow the questline until you complete Who Pulls the Strings.
In this ending, Crake explains that Catalin Dragosti (the son of Vale Sangora's former tyrant) is waiting outside the valley with an army, and you attack Eastridge Outpost to let him in.

Unsurprisingly, Catalin Dragosti is as bloodthirsty as his father and immediately executes some defenceless prisoners, though you can save at least two of them if you object. After Rise at Dawn, you attack Griefberg Castle in Fall Before Dusk, infiltrating through the tunnels below and battling some Kobolds.

The key variations here are that you won't save any of the prisoners, since Brencis knew you were coming. Vlad will also get a load of Manumits killed by rushing the gate if you save him in the intro , and encourage his recklessness in the Old Friends, New Friends quest where you talk to him in the Manumit hideout.
Finally, you'll reach the throne room, where Brencis will try to murder Catalin Dragosti.

After this, you'll continue to the banquet hall, with or without Crake, and will fight Brencis in a room with your family tied to chairs. Unlike the A Lone Wolf's Hunt ending, you can't make a deal with Brencis at this point, since you can't stop Catalin and his army. You'll fight and defeat Brencis, invite him in, or leave him in hell, and the epilogue in Laslea will play.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uHFuXVbY6Q6ErLcNKFpvpH.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s9NM69NDmrBgYwNpQcXPYH.jpg

This is one of the worst endings in my opinion. Catalin Dragosti undertakes a campaign of retribution against anyone he sees as having helped the Vrakhiri, burning entire districts of Svartrau and filling the castle dungeons. As you see in a note on a tree in Laslea, he also imposes a large tax and encourages people to inform on each other. The epilogue also mentions his mercenary army loots and pillages towns whenever it feels like it.

Perhaps the most heartbreaking part of this ending is it reveals who Crake really is—a toady for Catalin. Under Dragosti's orders, he undertakes a genocide of the Uriashi, seeing them as monsters just like the Vrakhiri. The plague also returns, as does Christianity, but there is a slight silver lining in that this is the only epilogue where you can talk to Crake in Laslea.
Midnight Reckoning
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7aU47sfdvYMgioMhRk38YQ.jpg
Coen helps Lacra end Brencis' sinister scheme.
Meet Lacra during the A Friend Like This quest, which you most likely get via the note on Ambrus's body in The Gilded Gauntlet , and then follow her questline until you unlock Midnight Reckoning.

Alongside Lacra, you enter the Griefberg Castle dungeons via the ancient ruins below and destroy Brencis's ritual, before ascending through the castle to face Brencis himself. The key variables here are that in smashing the ritual, Lacra unleashes hell on the castle. Corpses start coming back to life, huge chunks of the castle are ripped up into the air, and the prisoners lose their minds.
When you finally reach the throne room, your family will be overgrown in the red roots (but still alive). Brencis will appear to confront you and Lacra.

As with the other endings, you'll defeat Brencis in Anachora, and can decide whether to invite him in, or let him be consumed by hell. However, he'll also reveal more in this ending about his plan—that he wanted to accept and harness the curse of Anachora that all vampires harbor instead of trying to resist it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GZXMB3Fi7bQv5STBrwkHWH.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ci7syBKatczZT627s5oNkH.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Jd2Pq2xcMgh7T4iM5ewpgH.jpg

This ending isn't a particularly good one—as with A Lone Wolf's Hunt, Vale Sangora becomes independent for a time, the Manumits defend it, and both Christianity and the plague return. The negative here is basically everyone in the castle dies and it remains a cursed hellscape.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8H2F3G7p2ZVDt9oX4BcuHT.jpg

items.title: 我在 GTA 5 中填满了真实的洛杉矶雪
items.summary: Chestnuts roasting on an open car-fire.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Okay, two things. First: Los Santos Customs will be taking a hiatus next week, as I spend nine days in a row sleeping and attempting to develop the antibodies to counter whatever exotic German illness it is I acquired at Gamescom 2026 .
Second: it's snowing in Los Santos, just like the real-life LA.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3q5HfnmUhqwkozAxiWaN5h.jpg

I have installed WinterV Beta , with the aim of making Grand Theft Auto 5's weather a little more interesting than it usually is. The pitch is simple: what if there was snow? Well, reader, having played a little GTA 5 with WinterV Beta, I can assure you that there very much is snow. Plus, all the world's lighting takes on a kind of a sickly, ochre hue, which is also just like LA.

From the sky: flurries of flakes. On the roads: cars covered in a sheen of powder, tyre-chains inexplicably equipped (the snow does not, in my version of GTA 5 where a significant chunk of the exterior map has absconded to the phantom zone, settle). In the air: a crisp winter chill. Santa Claus is coming to town; fire a truck at him .

I can't tell you if the presence of snow on the city roads impacts car handling because, as we have established, cars in my GTA 5 no longer have handling . Nevertheless, it does change the vibe quite a lot. As someone who's spent a lot of the last month looking at GTA 5—a change is as good as a rest.
But also, it is time for a rest. I will see you the week after next, whereupon we'll probably finally convert this game into GTA 6. I can feel it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kkNtsnEsZiTdgmuFTn4pJ6.jpg

items.title: 一位受欢迎的主播拒绝了玩《Arc Raiders》的 6 位数交易，因为“这款游戏让我非常沮丧”
items.summary: Seven-figures? Now we're talking.

content.v: Everyone has a price. Maybe it's $100, maybe it's $1,000, maybe it's for someone to see your innate value as a human being, or maybe it's $1,000,000. Popular streamer TimTheTatman recently revealed what it would take to get him to go back to Arc Raiders , and spoilers, it's not the third option.

There was apparently an ad deal floating around for the Arc Raiders and Subway collab, which TimTheTatman was approached for, but did not entertain. "I did say no to six-figures with Arc Raiders, I did," he revealed in a stream earlier this week. "I said 'No thank you'. And it was the Subway Arc Raiders ad. I said I just can't do it, I'm sorry."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nbcyTKP3ArxM2bmu682tgg.jpg

This was met with the exact response you'd expect with people being baffled that he'd ever think of turning down such a lucrative offer. "That's kind of the funny part of being in a streamer position," TimTheTatman continued. "People say 'you're a fucking sellout' but then in the same breath I said I passed on six-figures from Arc Raiders and people are like 'you're fucking stupid'."

He revealed that he does actually have a price to play Arc Raiders again: they'd just have had to add another zero onto the offer. "If that Arc Raiders deal was seven-figures—hey boys welcome back to Arc Raiders and Subway, right, you see what I'm saying? 100% we're going back. But it's just for me, the game frustrated me so much—I got frustrated so much with that game, I just don't want to play it ever again. Even to a point where six-figures isn't going to get me back on it."

I can't say I'm surprised. Arc Raiders is in a bit of a rough spot right now, especially for streamers, what with all the cheating and stream sniping. Embark Studios' executive producer Aleksander Grøndal recently admitted the shortcomings of Arc Raiders and promised that its upcoming major update Frozen Trails will reset the game and provide enough incentive to get players to come back, though—even if they don't get a six-figure deal to do it.

others.title: Netflix 正在制作一部关于黑魔王斯特拉德·冯·扎罗维奇起源故事的真人版《龙与地下城》系列剧

content.v: Curse of Strahd is one of the most popular D&D modules for a reason—it's actually really compelling. Set in the misty, cursed lands of Barovia, Curse of Strahd is dominated by the titular Strahd von Zarovich, a vampire lord with a tragic backstory and a propensity for showing up at random intervals to give you a fantasy wedgie.
In the one Strahd campaign I played in, my first encounter with the man involved him bleeding our cleric and making my thief drink his blood—so, you know. Normal.

Anyway, per Deadline , we'll be getting a fully-fledged live action Netflix series about him dubbed Ravenloft—after the wider set of domains that darklords like Mr. Zarovich himself enjoy dominion over. It's being helmed by writer and executive producer John August and executive producer Alfonso Cuarón.

The latter of which worked on Harry Potter: The Prisoner of Azkaban. Fittingly, one of the darker Harry Potter films—and owner of exactly the kind of murky, grey aesthetic I'd anticipate in any series taking place in Ravenloft.

The report reads: "Described as a prestige fantasy series where adventure collides with gothic horror and tragic romance, Ravenloft and its Domains of Dread tackle adventure through character-driven stories of dark magic and supernatural intrigue.

"At its heart, the series follows the making of the vampire Darklord Strahd von Zarovich, whose story of power, love, obsession, and undead transformation charts his origins from tragic antihero to one of Dungeons & Dragons’ most notorious villains."

And hey, genuinely? I think this could work out great, assuming it can escape the executive Netflix meddling and second-screen scriptwriting that's been creeping its wormy fingers into games recently. Strahd's entire backstory is tragic enough and appealing enough that unwinding it underpins one of the most popular D&D modules.

I look forward to the season finale where, presumably, a group of four adventurers with increasingly absurd backstories and a sword made out of sunlight punt down his front door and kick his byronic ass.

items.title: 神谷英树 (Hideki Kamiya) 告诉 Xbox 首席执行官，当她准备好时，他已经准备好制作《Scalebound》
items.summary: Bayonetta creator Hideki Kamiya has a message for Xbox CEO Asha Sharma: When she's ready to make Scalebound, h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/04/scalebound-1788539011260.png
Bayonetta creator Hideki Kamiya has a message for Xbox CEO Asha Sharma: When she's ready to make Scalebound , he'll be waiting.

The action-game mastermind and Clovers studio head spoke about his desire to return to his canceled dragon IP during a recent interview with VGC . It's been a little more than nine years since Microsoft finally, officially confirmed it had shut down Scalebound after PlatinumGames announced it in 2014. Still, Kamiya said he's always ready to breathe life back into it.
When asked if he's contacted Sharma about Scalebound, he said, "Well, no, but now’s my opportunity to once again say that if they want to do it, let’s make it happen!"
"[Clovers president Kento Koyama] is on board too," he added. Kamiya then asked the site to include some of what little Scalebound footage was released to the public just so Sharma could take a look.
Kamiya and the rest of PlatinumGames announced the now-canned Xbox One-exclusive action-RPG 12 years ago at E3 2014. A lot has changed since then.

Scalebound eventually returned for gamescom 2015 , one year later, but then mostly went quiet. A delay to 2017 then stoked fears that the project may be in trouble, with a follow-up report then suggesting it could be in trouble before Microsoft delivered the final blow.

Although Kamiya no longer works at PlatinumGames, he confirmed he had moved on to help form Clovers in late 2024 . Although that team is heads down working on Okami 2 , it doesn't mean he isn't hoping to return to Scalebound one day. It's a project he and other PlatinumGames devs have expressed interest in returning to plenty of times over the years. Now, he's hoping Sharma can help make it happen.

During his interview with VGC, Kamiya recalled a recent dinner he had with some of the Scalebound team. He noted the canceled video game wasn't the only thing they talked about, but "it did come up a few times," and they "all remembered how fun it was to work" on it.

"Obviously, there were some tough times as well, but the fact that people still look back on that time with a lot of fun is something that I find very gratifying as the director of the project," Kamiya explained. "Of course, it’s very unfortunate that the project was unable to see the light of day ultimately, and that is something that even now I still very strongly desire to be able to see through if it’s all possible, and I’m being one hundred percent serious when I say that.

Kamiya said Clovers "might not be in a position" to work on Scalebound "right this second," but it's still something he's seeking out. He went as far as to say, "I strongly believe that if you want something strongly enough, you eventually find a way to make it happen."

"That’s the case with Okami right now," he continued, "where even after all these years, the opportunity once again presented itself, and I hope that will be the case with Scalebound in the future as well."

Like Kamiya, Xbox has gone through its own changes recently. Sharma took over for Phil Spencer as CEO in February of this year, leading to a waterfall of snappy changes at Microsoft's gaming wing that have been received both positively and negatively by fans. For example, the company announced last week it would allow players to digitize their physical games . That move in particular seems to have gone over well with fans, but it's done little to cushion the blow that came after Xbox announced it would be laying off 3,200 staff and shedding studios like Double Fine and Ninja Theory in July.
Whether Sharma and the rest of Xbox have room to make Scalebound happen remains to be seen. While we wait to see what the future holds, you can read what Kamiya had to say about the game in 2021 .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: 你吃的全麦面包是假的？！央视曝光染色假全麦面包
items.summary: 调查曝光，市面上多款打着健康旗号售卖的全麦面包实为“染色假货”。商家以精制小麦粉作为首要原料，仅少量添加麸皮，甚至依靠焦糖…

content.v: 随着大众健康意识提升，控糖降压、减脂瘦身成为日常需求，全麦、全谷物食品迎来热销。全麦面包、杂粮麦片、全麦馒头等粗粮产品摆满各大商超货架。但不少普通消费者存在认知误区，误将染色面包当作全麦食品，或是简单认为多谷物等同于全谷物，很容易落入商家设置的消费陷阱。
近日，经过央视记者调查曝光，市面上多款打着减脂、健康旗号售卖的全麦面包实为 “染色假货”。商家以精制小麦粉作为首要原料，仅少量添加麸皮，甚至依靠焦糖色素调出深褐色外观，伪装成全麦产品，误导不少控糖、减脂的消费者。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609020936485099.jpg
全谷物属于大类概念，全麦只是全谷物当中的一个分支。全谷物食品需要在去掉不可食用外壳后，完整保留种皮、胚芽、胚乳三大部分，糙米、燕麦、玉米、荞麦、藜麦都属于全谷物；只有小麦完整籽粒研磨而成的全麦粉制作的食品，才可称作全麦产品，全麦一定属于全谷物，但全谷物并不等于全麦。
按照相关标准，全谷物原料占比达到25%以上的谷物制品，才有资格称作全谷物制品。食品专家提醒消费者，倘若全麦、全谷物配料排在配料表靠后位置，实际含量不足25%，该产品便不能标注“全麦”“全谷物”字样，仅能算作风味杂粮食品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609020936492452.jpg
业内人士也给出如何辨别真假全麦面包的建议，看配料表首位：真全麦面包的配料表第一位必须是“全麦粉”或“全麦小麦粉”；如果第一位是“小麦粉”，即使颜色再深也是假货。真正全麦面包的膳食纤维含量通常≥6g/100g，而伪全麦面包的膳食纤维往往低于3g/100g。
除此之外，面包外观与口感也可作为辨别依据。真全麦面包颜色为自然灰褐色、浅棕色，切面清晰可见麦麸颗粒，入口口感粗糙、嚼劲充足；依靠焦糖色素染色的假全麦面包色泽黑亮均匀，吃起来松软香甜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609020936492414.jpg
据了解，当前我国还没有全麦面包对应的强制性国家标准，部分商家钻规则漏洞，依靠文字游戏混淆概念。新版《预包装食品标签通则》将于 2027 年正式落地实施，新规生效后，标注“全麦”的产品必须强制标明全谷物具体含量，市场乱象将得到进一步整治。
消费者选购全麦面包时，优先查看配料表和营养成分表，不要仅凭面包颜色判断品质，避免花高价买到染色“假全麦”。

items.title: 再也不怕被放鸽子！滴滴顺风车将对无故爽约动真格
items.summary: 滴滴顺风车更新取消判责规则，专门整治临行乱取消、无故爽约这类让人头疼的问题。不管是车主临时放乘客鸽子，还是乘客临时跳车，这…

content.v: 滴滴顺风车更新取消判责规则，专门整治临行乱取消、无故爽约这类让人头疼的问题。不管是车主临时放乘客鸽子，还是乘客临时跳车，这类行为一直都是顺风车里的高频矛盾。
平台收集了大量车主和乘客的真实反馈。不少乘客吐槽，到路边等车，车主直接失联，临时说不去，白白浪费时间。车主也有很多委屈，提前约好订单，出发前1小时乘客说不来，空跑一趟，时间油钱全部打水漂。
这套判责规则不是只要取消就会被罚。提前协商好，或是遇到不可抗力的情况，取消是不会被追责。平台主要管的是临近出发，毫无理由突然反悔，搞得另一方措手不及的临行取消行为。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609022141583453.png
平台一共划分4种判定结果：
无责就是不可抗力或者双方沟通协商后取消，不会带来任何影响。
一般有责是自身原因取消，没有主观恶意，会给到黄牌处置。
严重有责属于主观恶意，会触发红牌。
其他有责指的是剩下非临时取消的有责情况，做警告和规则学习处理。
车主有3类行为直接算严重违规，查到直接红牌处罚。行程里面私自拼人拉货，接单之后严重迟到玩消失，诱导乘客脱离平台私下交易，触碰红线会暂停服务3天，屡犯还会永久封禁账号。
平台也给出4条实用建议，接单之前想清楚时间路线合不合适，拿不准就不要接单。遇到突发状况第一时间跟对方沟通，不要直接失联。不要私加交易、私自拼客。好好沟通，大部分矛盾其实都能避免。
值得一提，现在优先落地车主侧判责，乘客的判责能力还在开发，后续会逐步上线，最终实现双向约束。如果觉得判责有误，用户可以直接在页面提交申诉，上传聊天记录、截图等证据等待复核。不少人都遇到过顺风车爽约，这套新规就是要保护守约的一方，约束随便毁约的人，改善整体的出行体验。

items.title: 四年心血!《黎明行者之血》总监：把孩子交给玩家
items.summary: 《黎明行者之血》已于9月3日正式发售，游戏总监Konrad Tomaszkiewicz在社交媒体发布动情长文，回顾工作室四年创业历程。

content.v: 《黎明行者之血》已于9月3日正式发售，游戏总监Konrad Tomaszkiewicz在社交媒体发布动情长文，回顾工作室四年创业历程，将这款作品称为团队的 "孩子"，正式交托到玩家手中。
Konrad在文中写道："四年前，一小群朋友聚在一起，决定去做一件看似不可能的事：创造一款真正独特的RPG。" 正是这个朴素的念头，催生了Rebel Wolves工作室。从最初的几人小团队，到如今拥有160名成员的成熟工作室，他们用四年时间完成了自己的处女作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/03/small_202609031638235208.png
他特别感谢了团队每一位成员、一路同行的合作伙伴、始终理解支持的家人，以及从项目初期就陪伴至今的玩家们。"这款游戏是为你们而做，也是被你们和你们的反馈所塑造的。"Konrad 强调，《黎明行者之血》是一款"由玩家制作、为玩家制作"的游戏，团队将自己的 "孩子" 交到玩家手中，希望大家能感受到这份诚意。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/03/small_202609031643038366.png
作为《巫师3：狂猎》核心团队成员出走后组建的独立工作室，Rebel Wolves的首款作品自公布起就备受关注。此前媒体评分解禁 Metacritic 均分83分，发售首日Steam在线峰值突破4.4万，Twitch观众峰值近10万，登顶Steam畅销榜，交出了一份亮眼的首秀成绩单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/03/small_202609031643114569.png
